        .from('user_blocks')
        .select('id')
        .or('and(blocker_id.eq.' + user.id + ',blocked_id.eq.' + targetUuid + '),and(blocker_id.eq.' + targetUuid + ',blocked_id.eq.' + user.id + ')')
        .maybeSingle();

      if (existingBlock) {
        router.replace('/messages');
        return;
      }

      const { data: remoteMsgs } = await supabase
        .from('messages')
        .select('id, sender_id, receiver_id, content, created_at, is_quarantined, is_read')
        .or('and(sender_id.eq.' + user.id + ',receiver_id.eq.' + targetUuid + '),and(sender_id.eq.' + targetUuid + ',receiver_id.eq.' + user.id + ')')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: true });

      if (remoteMsgs) {
        setMessages(
          remoteMsgs
            .filter((m: any) => m.sender_id === user.id || !m.is_quarantined)
            .map((m: any) => ({
              id: m.id,
              sender: m.sender_id === user.id ? 'me' : 'them',
              text: m.content,
              time: new Date(m.created_at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
              read: Boolean(m.is_read),
            }))
        );
      }
    }

    initUserAndTarget();
  }, [rawParam, router]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!resolvedTargetUuid || !currentUserId) return;

    let isMounted = true;
    const channelName = 'chat_' + [resolvedTargetUuid, currentUserId].sort().join('_');

    const channel = supabase
      .channel(channelName)
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'messages' },
        (payload) => {
          if (!isMounted) return;
          if (payload.eventType === 'UPDATE') {
            const updated = payload.new as any;
            setMessages((prev) =>
              prev.map((m) => (m.id === updated.id ? { ...m, read: Boolean(updated.is_read) } : m))
            );
            return;
          }

          if (payload.eventType === 'INSERT') {
            const newRow = payload.new as any;
            const recId = newRow.receiver_id || newRow.recipient_id;
            const isFromTarget = newRow.sender_id === resolvedTargetUuid && recId === currentUserId;

            if (isFromTarget && !newRow.is_quarantined) {
              setMessages((prev) => {
                if (prev.some((m) => m.id === newRow.id)) return prev;
                return [
                  ...prev,
                  {
                    id: newRow.id,
                    sender: 'them',
                    text: newRow.content,
                    time: new Date(newRow.created_at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
                    read: true,
                  },
                ];
              });
            }
          }
        }
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      supabase.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, [resolvedTargetUuid, currentUserId]);

  const handleSendMessage = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const clean = inputText.trim();
    if (!clean || cooldownSeconds > 0 || !resolvedTargetUuid) return;

    setErrorBanner(null);
    const { sanitized, wasMasked } = sanitizeMessage(clean);
    if (wasMasked) setShowSafetyNotice(true);

    const tempId = 'temp-' + Date.now();
    const myNewMsg: ChatMessage = {
      id: tempId,
      sender: 'me',
      text: sanitized,
      time: 'Just now',
      read: false,
    };

    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, myNewMsg]);
    setInputText('');
    setShowIcebreaker(false);

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/messages', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          receiverId: resolvedTargetUuid,
          content: sanitized,
        }),
      });

      const resData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));

      if (!res.ok) {
        setMessages((prev) => prev.filter((m) => m.id !== tempId));
        setErrorBanner(resData.error || 'Message could not be delivered.');
        if (resData.code === 'OUTREACH_LIMIT_REACHED') {
          setShowUpgradeModal(true);
        }
        return;
      }

      const nextCount = sentCount + 1;
      setSentCount(nextCount);
      if (nextCount >= 5 && !isPlus) {
        setCooldownSeconds(300);
      }

      if (resData?.message?.id) {
        setMessages((prev) =>
          prev.map((m) =>
            m.id === tempId
              ? { ...m, id: resData.message.id, warning: resData.warning }
              : m
          )
        );
      }
    } catch {
      setMessages((prev) => prev.filter((m) => m.id !== tempId));
      setErrorBanner('Network error while sending message.');
    }
  };

  const handleBlockUser = async () => {
    const target = resolvedTargetUuid || rawParam;
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/users/block', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ blockedId: target }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setActionDoneMsg('User has been blocked. Redirecting to messages...');
        setTimeout(() => {
          setShowReportModal(false);
          setActionDoneMsg(null);
          router.push('/messages');
        }, 1200);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const handleReportUser = async (reason: string = 'harassment') => {
    const target = resolvedTargetUuid || rawParam;
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/users/report', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ reportedId: target, reason }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setActionDoneMsg('Report submitted. Thank you for keeping Asians in Love safe.');
        setTimeout(() => {
          setShowReportModal(false);
          setActionDoneMsg(null);
        }, 1500);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const formatTimer = (secs: number) => {
    const mins = Math.floor(secs / 60);
    const remaining = secs % 60;
    return mins + ':' + (remaining < 10 ? '0' : '') + remaining;
  };

  return (
    <main className="w-full min-h-[calc(100dvh-64px)] flex flex-col bg-[#F8F7FA] text-[#1C1924] font-sans relative">
      {/* Pristine Dating App Chat Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 bg-white border-b border-[#DDD7E5] shrink-0">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
          <Link href="/messages" className="p-1.5 -ml-1 text-[#524B5E] hover:text-[#6555B8] transition rounded-full hover:bg-[#F3EFFC] shrink-0">
            <ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5" />
          </Link>
          <Link href={'/profile/' + (resolvedTargetUuid || rawParam)} className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
            <div className="relative w-10 h-10 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-[#DDD7E5] shrink-0 bg-[#F3EFFC]">
              <Image src={targetInfo.avatar} alt={targetInfo.name} fill sizes="40px" className="object-cover" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0">
              <span
                className="text-sm font-bold text-[#1C1924] leading-tight truncate"
                style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-brand)' }}
              >
                @{targetInfo.name}
              </span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
                <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 inline-block shrink-0" />
                <span className="text-[11px] text-[#6C637B] font-medium truncate">
                  {targetInfo.city ? targetInfo.city : 'Active now'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Link>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowRepModal(true)}
            className={
              'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer border ' +
              (targetInfo.rep < 60
                ? 'bg-amber-50 border-amber-300 text-amber-800'
                : 'bg-[#F3EFFC] border-[#DDD7E5] text-[#6555B8] hover:bg-[#EAE0F5]')
            }
          >
            {targetInfo.rep}% Rep
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowReportModal(true)}
            className="p-1.5 text-[#8C849B] hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 rounded-full transition"
            title="Safety & Moderation"
          >
            <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Message Stream */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 pb-44 space-y-3">
        {showIcebreaker && icebreakerPrompt && messages.length < 3 && (
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-3xl bg-white border border-[#DDD7E5] shadow-xs space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-[#6555B8]">
                <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#6555B8]" />
                <span>Talk Advice • Conversation Starter</span>
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowIcebreaker(false)}
                className="text-[#8C849B] hover:text-[#1C1924] p-0.5"
                aria-label="Dismiss icebreaker"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#524B5E] leading-relaxed bg-[#F8F7FA] p-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-[#F0EDF5]">
              &ldquo;{icebreakerPrompt}&rdquo;
            </p>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setInputText(icebreakerPrompt)}
              className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#6555B8] hover:underline cursor-pointer"
            >
              Tap to use this icebreaker &rarr;
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {targetInfo.rep < 60 && (
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-amber-50/90 border border-amber-200 text-xs text-amber-900 flex items-start gap-2.5 shadow-xs">
            <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div className="leading-relaxed">
              <span className="font-semibold text-amber-950">Safety Caution:</span> This member has a low reputation score ({targetInfo.rep}%). Never send money or share financial details.
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {errorBanner && (
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-xs text-rose-700 font-medium">
            {errorBanner}
          </div>
        )}

        {showSafetyNotice && (
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#F3EFFC] border border-[#DDD7E5] text-xs text-[#6555B8] flex items-start gap-2.5 shadow-xs">
            <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 text-[#6555B8] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <p className="leading-relaxed">
              <strong className="font-semibold">Safety Gate:</strong> External contact handles and phone digits unlock after 3 substantive replies from both members.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}

        {messages.map((msg) => (
          <div
            key={msg.id}
            className={'flex flex-col ' + (msg.sender === 'me' ? 'items-end' : 'items-start')}
          >
            <div
              className={
                'max-w-[82%] px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl text-xs leading-relaxed shadow-xs select-text ' +
                (msg.sender === 'me'
                  ? 'bg-[#6555B8] text-white font-normal rounded-br-xs'
                  : 'bg-white text-[#1C1924] border border-[#DDD7E5] rounded-bl-xs')
              }
            >
              {msg.text}
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mt-1 text-[10px] text-[#8C849B]">
              <span>{msg.time}</span>
              {msg.sender === 'me' && (
                msg.read ? (
                  <CheckCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-[#6555B8]" />
                ) : (
                  <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-[#8C849B]" />
                )
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
        <div ref={chatEndRef} />
      </div>

      {/* Input Bar pinned cleanly above BottomNav */}
      <div className="fixed bottom-[84px] inset-x-0 z-30 max-w-[430px] mx-auto bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-[#DDD7E5] p-3">
        {cooldownSeconds > 0 ? (
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#F8F7FA] border border-[#DDD7E5] flex flex-col items-center gap-2 shadow-xs text-center">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-[#524B5E]">
              <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
              <span>Next free message unlocks in</span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-xl font-bold tracking-wider text-[#1C1924]">
              {formatTimer(cooldownSeconds)}
            </span>
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowUpgradeModal(true)}
              className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#6555B8] hover:bg-[#52449e] text-white font-semibold text-xs shadow-md transition"
            >
              <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current" />
              Skip the Wait with Plus
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSendMessage} className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Write a message..."
              value={inputText}
              onChange={(e) => setInputText(e.target.value)}
              className="flex-1 bg-[#F8F7FA] border border-[#DDD7E5] focus:border-[#6555B8] focus:bg-white text-[#1C1924] placeholder-[#8C849B] rounded-full px-4 py-2.5 text-xs outline-none transition-all focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#6555B8]/15"
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={!inputText.trim()}
              className="p-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#6555B8] hover:bg-[#52449e] active:scale-90 disabled:opacity-40 text-white transition-all shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>

      <UpgradeModal
        isOpen={showUpgradeModal}
        onClose={() => setShowUpgradeModal(false)}
        triggerContext="chat"
      />
      <ReputationModal
        isOpen={showRepModal}
        onClose={() => setShowRepModal(false)}
        name={targetInfo.name}
        score={targetInfo.rep}
      />
      {showReportModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4 backdrop-blur-xs">
          <div className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-3xl bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl border border-[#DDD7E5]">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-rose-600">
              <ShieldAlert className="h-5 w-5" />
              <h3
                className="font-bold text-[#1C1924]"
                style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-brand)' }}
              >
                Safety &amp; Moderation
              </h3>
            </div>
            <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-[#6C637B] leading-relaxed">
              Take action regarding this member. Reports are reviewed by moderators within 24 hours.
            </p>
            {actionDoneMsg ? (
              <div className="mt-4 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 p-3 text-center text-xs font-medium text-emerald-800">
                {actionDoneMsg}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="mt-5 space-y-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleBlockUser}
                  className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-[#DDD7E5] py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[#1C1924] hover:bg-[#F3EFFC] transition"
                >
                  Block Member
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleReportUser('harassment')}
                  className="w-full rounded-2xl bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition"
                >
                  Report Violation / Scammer
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setShowReportModal(false);
                setActionDoneMsg(null);
              }}
              className="mt-3 w-full py-1.5 text-xs text-[#8C849B] hover:text-[#1C1924] transition"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}

interface DiscoverCardPhotoCarouselProps {
  profileId: string;
  photos?: string[];
  avatarUrl: string;
  name: string;
  repScore: number;
  sharedCount: number;
  online: boolean;
  recentlyActive?: boolean;

function DiscoverCardPhotoCarousel({
  profileId,
  photos,
  avatarUrl,
  name,
  repScore,
  sharedCount,
  online,
  recentlyActive,
}: DiscoverCardPhotoCarouselProps) {
  const [currentIdx, setCurrentIdx] = useState(0);

  const rawList = (photos && photos.length > 0 ? photos : [avatarUrl]).filter(
    (p): p is string => typeof p === 'string' && p.trim().length > 0 && p !== '/placeholder-avatar.svg'
  );
  const uniqueList = Array.from(new Set(rawList));
  const displayPhotos = uniqueList.length > 0 ? uniqueList : [avatarUrl || '/placeholder-avatar.svg'];
  const hasMultiple = displayPhotos.length > 1;

  const handlePrev = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setCurrentIdx((prev) => (prev === 0 ? displayPhotos.length - 1 : prev - 1));
  };

  const handleNext = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setCurrentIdx((prev) => (prev === displayPhotos.length - 1 ? 0 : prev + 1));
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative block h-full w-full overflow-hidden bg-[#F2EEF7] select-none">
      <Link href={'/profile/' + profileId} className="absolute inset-0 z-0">
        <img
          src={displayPhotos[currentIdx]}
          alt={name}
          className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-[1.03] transition-transform duration-500 ease-out"
          loading="lazy"
        />
      </Link>

      {(displayPhotos.length > 1) && (
        <span className="absolute bottom-1.5 right-1.5 z-10 inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-black/55 text-white text-[10px] font-semibold pointer-events-none">
          <Camera className="w-3 h-3" />
          {displayPhotos.length}
        </span>
      )}

      {/* Fixed Top-Left Consistent Reputation Pill */}
      <div
        className={
          'absolute ' +
          (hasMultiple ? 'top-4' : 'top-2.5') +
          ' left-2.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 z-20 pointer-events-none'
        }
      >
        <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xs text-[10px] font-medium text-white">
          <span>{repScore ? repScore + '% Rep' : '100% Rep'}</span>
        </div>

        {online ? (
          <span className="presence-dot h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 ring-2 ring-white/90 shadow-xs shrink-0" />
        ) : recentlyActive ? (
          <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 ring-1.5 ring-white/80 shadow-xs shrink-0" />
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {/* Split-Touch Photo Carousel Zones */}


      {hasMultiple && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between absolute inset-x-1.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-20 pointer-events-none">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handlePrev}
            className="pointer-events-auto p-1.5 rounded-full bg-black/40 hover:bg-black/70 text-white backdrop-blur-xs transition active:scale-90"
            aria-label="Previous photo"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleNext}
            className="pointer-events-auto p-1.5 rounded-full bg-black/40 hover:bg-black/70 text-white backdrop-blur-xs transition active:scale-90"
            aria-label="Next photo"
          >
            <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function normalizeGenderValue(raw?: string | null): 'woman' | 'man' | 'trans_woman' | 'trans_man' | 'non_binary' {
  const val = String(raw || '').toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[\s-]+/g, '_');
  if (['man', 'men', 'male', 'm', 'guy', 'guys'].includes(val)) return 'man';
  if (['woman', 'women', 'female', 'f', 'lady', 'ladies', 'girl', 'girls'].includes(val)) return 'woman';
  if (['trans_woman', 'trans_women', 'transgender_woman', 'transgender_women', 'trans', 'mtf', 'transfemale'].includes(val)) return 'trans_woman';
  if (['trans_man', 'trans_men', 'transgender_man', 'transgender_men', 'ftm', 'transmale'].includes(val)) return 'trans_man';
  if (['non_binary', 'nonbinary', 'nb', 'enby'].includes(val)) return 'non_binary';
  return 'woman';
}

function formatConciseIntent(raw?: string | null): string {
  if (!raw) return toIntentLabel('serious');
  const mapped = toIntentLabel(raw);
  if (mapped !== String(raw).trim()) return mapped;
  const lower = mapped.toLowerCase();
  if (lower.includes('marriage') || lower.includes('serious')) return 'The Real Thing';
  if (lower.includes('long-term') || lower.includes('long term') || lower.includes('life partner')) return 'Long-Term';
  if (lower.includes('casual') || lower.includes('dating')) return 'Keeping It Light';
  return mapped.length <= 24 ? mapped : mapped.slice(0, 22);
}

function DiscoverContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const [discoveryMode, setDiscoveryMode] = useState<DiscoveryModeId>('all');

  const pillTrackRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const pillIsDraggingRef = useRef(false);
  const pillStartXRef = useRef(0);
  const pillScrollLeftRef = useRef(0);
  const pillDraggedRef = useRef(false);

  const handlePillMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    const slider = pillTrackRef.current;
    if (!slider) return;
    pillIsDraggingRef.current = true;
    pillDraggedRef.current = false;
    pillStartXRef.current = e.pageX - slider.offsetLeft;
    pillScrollLeftRef.current = slider.scrollLeft;
  };

  const handlePillMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (!pillIsDraggingRef.current || !pillTrackRef.current) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const slider = pillTrackRef.current;
    const x = e.pageX - slider.offsetLeft;
    const walk = (x - pillStartXRef.current) * 1.3;
    if (Math.abs(walk) > 4) {
      pillDraggedRef.current = true;
    }
    slider.scrollLeft = pillScrollLeftRef.current - walk;
  };

  const handlePillMouseUp = () => {
    pillIsDraggingRef.current = false;
    setTimeout(() => {
      pillDraggedRef.current = false;
    }, 60);
  };

  const handlePillWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent) => {
    const slider = pillTrackRef.current;
    if (!slider) return;
    if (e.deltaY !== 0) {
      slider.scrollLeft += e.deltaY;
    }
  };

  const [currentUserCoords, setCurrentUserCoords] = useState<{ lat: number; lon: number } | null>(null);
  const [viewerInterests, setViewerInterests] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [viewerIntent, setViewerIntent] = useState<string>('');
  const [viewerSavedGenders, setViewerSavedGenders] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState<ProfileItem[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState(() => searchParams.get('q') || '');
  const [selectedCountry, setSelectedCountry] = useState(() => {
    const c = searchParams.get('country');
    return c && c.toLowerCase() !== 'all' ? c : 'All';
  });

  const userSelectedGenderManually = useRef(Boolean(searchParams.get('gender')));
  const [selectedGenders, setSelectedGenders] = useState<string[]>(() => {
    // Priority: localStorage manual choice > URL param > server/default
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem('discover_gender_pref');
      if (stored !== null) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
          if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;
        } catch {}
      }
    }
    const g = searchParams.get('gender');
    if (!g || g.toLowerCase() === 'all') return [];
    return g.split(',').map((s) => normalizeGenderValue(s));
  });

  // Persist manual gender selection to localStorage
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('discover_gender_pref', JSON.stringify(selectedGenders));
      } catch {}
    }
  }, [selectedGenders]);

  const toggleGender = (gender: string) => {
    userSelectedGenderManually.current = true;
    setSelectedGenders((prev) =>
      prev.includes(gender) ? prev.filter((g) => g !== gender) : [...prev, gender]
    );
  };

  const [filtersOpen, setFiltersOpen] = useState(false);
  const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isCountryOpen, setIsCountryOpen] = useState(false);
  const countryDropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  const [minAge, setMinAge] = useState<number>(() => {
    const val = Number(searchParams.get('minAge'));
    return !isNaN(val) && val >= 18 && val <= 80 ? val : 18;
  });
  const [maxAge, setMaxAge] = useState<number>(() => {
    const val = Number(searchParams.get('maxAge'));
    return !isNaN(val) && val >= 18 && val <= 80 ? val : 65;
  });
  const [draftMinAge, setDraftMinAge] = useState<number>(minAge);
  const [draftMaxAge, setDraftMaxAge] = useState<number>(maxAge);

  const [selectedIntent, setSelectedIntent] = useState<string>(() => searchParams.get('intent') || 'All');
  const [verifiedOnly, setVerifiedOnly] = useState<boolean>(() => searchParams.get('verified') === 'true');
  const [activeNowOnly, setActiveNowOnly] = useState<boolean>(() => searchParams.get('active') === 'true');

  const [matchedModalProfile, setMatchedModalProfile] = useState<{ id: string; name: string; avatarUrl?: string } | null>(null);
  const [isModalClosing, setIsModalClosing] = useState(false);
  const [cardActions, setCardActions] = useState<Record<string, ActionType>>({});
  const [lastPassed, setLastPassed] = useState<{ id: string; name: string } | null>(null);

  const BATCH_SIZE = 12;
  const [visibleLimit, setVisibleLimit] = useState(BATCH_SIZE);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (filtersOpen) {
      setDraftMinAge(minAge);
      setDraftMaxAge(maxAge);
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    };
  }, [filtersOpen, minAge, maxAge]);

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event: MouseEvent) {
      if (countryDropdownRef.current && !countryDropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsCountryOpen(false);
      }
    }
    if (isCountryOpen) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    }
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, [isCountryOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMutualMatch = (e: CustomEvent<{ targetId: string }>) => {
      const target = profiles.find((p) => p.id === e.detail.targetId);
      if (target) {
        playMatchChime();
        setMatchedModalProfile({
          id: target.id,
          name: target.name,
          avatarUrl: target.avatarUrl,
        });
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('ail-mutual-match' as any, handleMutualMatch);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('ail-mutual-match' as any, handleMutualMatch);
  }, [profiles]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const local = getLocalCardActions();
    setCardActions(local);

    async function loadFeed() {
      setIsLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/discover', { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (res.ok) {
          const payload = await res.json();
          const v = payload.viewer;

          if (v) {
            if (v.onboarding_completed === false) {
              router.push('/onboarding');
              return;
            }
            if (v.latitude && v.longitude) {
              setCurrentUserCoords({ lat: v.latitude, lon: v.longitude });
            }
            if (Array.isArray(v.interests)) {
              setViewerInterests(v.interests);
            }
            if (v.intent) {
              setViewerIntent(v.intent);
            }
            if (Array.isArray(v.interested_in) && v.interested_in.length > 0) {
              setViewerSavedGenders(v.interested_in);
              // Only apply server preference if user has NEVER made a manual choice (nothing in localStorage)
              let hasManualChoice = false;
              if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
                const stored = localStorage.getItem('discover_gender_pref');
                if (stored !== null) hasManualChoice = true;
              }
              if (!hasManualChoice) {
                setSelectedGenders(v.interested_in);
              }
            }
          }

          if (Array.isArray(payload.favoriteIds)) {
            setCardActions((prev) => {
              const merged = { ...prev };
              payload.favoriteIds.forEach((fid: string) => {
                merged[fid] = 'like';
              });
              return merged;
            });
          }

          if (Array.isArray(payload.profiles)) {
            setProfiles(payload.profiles);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to load discovery profiles:', err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }

    loadFeed();
  }, [router]);

  const computeSharedCount = (profile: ProfileItem): number => {
    let count = 0;
    if (viewerInterests.length > 0 && Array.isArray(profile.interests)) {
      const viewerSet = new Set(viewerInterests.map((i) => i.toLowerCase()));
      profile.interests.forEach((tag) => {
        if (viewerSet.has(tag.toLowerCase())) count++;
      });
    }
    if (viewerIntent && profile.intent && viewerIntent.toLowerCase() === profile.intent.toLowerCase()) {
      count++;
    }
    return count;
  };

  const closeModalWithAnimation = () => {
    setIsModalClosing(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setMatchedModalProfile(null);
      setIsModalClosing(false);
    }, 220);
  };

  const triggerAction = async (id: string, action: ActionType, name?: string, avatarUrl?: string) => {
    const currentAction = cardActions[id];
    const isCurrentlyActive = currentAction === action;

    setCardActions((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      if (isCurrentlyActive) {
        delete next[id];
      } else {
        next[id] = action;
      }
      return next;
    });

    if (action === 'pass' && !isCurrentlyActive && name) {
      setLastPassed({ id, name });
    } else if (lastPassed?.id === id) {
      setLastPassed(null);
    }

    await persistCardAction(supabase, id, action, isCurrentlyActive);

    if (action === 'like' && !isCurrentlyActive) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/spark', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ targetUserId: id }),
        });
        const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        if (data?.mutual) {
          playMatchChime();
          setMatchedModalProfile({
            id,
            name: name || 'Member',
            avatarUrl: avatarUrl || '/placeholder-avatar.svg',
          });
        }
      } catch {
        // Non-blocking spark check
      }
    }
  };

  const undoLastPass = () => {
    if (!lastPassed) return;
    const targetId = lastPassed.id;
    setCardActions((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      delete next[targetId];
      return next;
    });
    persistCardAction(supabase, targetId, 'pass', true);
    setLastPassed(null);
  };

  const activeFiltersCount = useMemo(() => {
    let count = 0;
    if (selectedCountry.toLowerCase() !== 'all') count++;
    if (minAge > 18 || maxAge < 65) count++;
    if (selectedIntent !== 'All') count++;
    if (verifiedOnly) count++;
    if (activeNowOnly) count++;
    if (discoveryMode !== 'all') count++;
    return count;
  }, [selectedCountry, minAge, maxAge, selectedIntent, verifiedOnly, activeNowOnly, discoveryMode]);

  const applyFilters = () => {
    setMinAge(draftMinAge);
    setMaxAge(draftMaxAge);
    setFiltersOpen(false);
  };

  const resetFilters = () => {
    setDiscoveryMode('all');
    setSelectedGenders(viewerSavedGenders.length > 0 ? viewerSavedGenders : []);
    setSelectedCountry('All');
    setSearchQuery('');
    setMinAge(18);
    setMaxAge(65);
    setDraftMinAge(18);
    setDraftMaxAge(65);
    setSelectedIntent('All');
    setVerifiedOnly(false);
    setActiveNowOnly(false);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        localStorage.removeItem('ail_passed_ids');
      } catch {}
    }
    setCardActions((prev) => {
      const cleaned: Record<string, ActionType> = {};
      Object.entries(prev).forEach(([k, v]) => {
        if (v !== 'pass') cleaned[k] = v;
      });
      return cleaned;
    });
  };

  const filteredProfiles = useMemo(() => {
    const base = profiles.filter((profile) => {
      if (cardActions[profile.id] === 'pass') return false;

      const matchesCountry =
        selectedCountry.toLowerCase() === 'all' ||
        (profile.country || '').toLowerCase() === selectedCountry.toLowerCase();

      const matchesGender =
        selectedGenders.length === 0 || selectedGenders.includes(profile.gender);

      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      const matchesQuery =
        !q ||
        profile.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        profile.location.toLowerCase().includes(q);

      const matchesAge = profile.age >= minAge && profile.age <= maxAge;
      const matchesIntent =
        selectedIntent === 'All' || !profile.intent || profile.intent === selectedIntent;
      const matchesVerified = !verifiedOnly || profile.verified;
      const matchesOnline = !activeNowOnly || profile.online;

      const matchesDiscoveryMode = (() => {
        if (discoveryMode === 'online') {
          return Boolean(profile.online || profile.recentlyActive);
        }
        if (discoveryMode === 'near_me') {
          if (currentUserCoords && profile.latitude && profile.longitude) {
            const R = 6371;
            const dLat = ((profile.latitude - currentUserCoords.lat) * Math.PI) / 180;
            const dLon = ((profile.longitude - currentUserCoords.lon) * Math.PI) / 180;
            const a =
              Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
              Math.cos((currentUserCoords.lat * Math.PI) / 180) *
                Math.cos((profile.latitude * Math.PI) / 180) *
                Math.sin(dLon / 2) *
                Math.sin(dLon / 2);
            const distKm = R * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
            return distKm <= 500;
          }
          return true;
        }
        if (discoveryMode === 'new') {
          const createdAt = profile.created_at ? new Date(profile.created_at).getTime() : 0;
          return createdAt > Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
        }
        return true;
      })();

      return (
        matchesCountry &&
        matchesGender &&
        matchesQuery &&
        matchesAge &&
        matchesIntent &&
        matchesVerified &&
        matchesOnline &&
        matchesDiscoveryMode
      );
    });

    if (discoveryMode === 'new') {
      return [...base].sort((a, b) => {
        const tA = a.created_at ? new Date(a.created_at).getTime() : 0;
        const tB = b.created_at ? new Date(b.created_at).getTime() : 0;
        return tB - tA;
      });
    }
    return base;
  }, [
    profiles,
    cardActions,
    selectedCountry,
    selectedGenders,
    searchQuery,
    minAge,
    maxAge,
    selectedIntent,
    verifiedOnly,
    activeNowOnly,
    discoveryMode,
    currentUserCoords,
  ]);

  const visibleProfiles = filteredProfiles.slice(0, visibleLimit);
  const hasMore = visibleLimit < filteredProfiles.length;

  return (
    <div className="w-full min-h-full bg-[#F8F7FA] text-[#1C1924] flex flex-col font-sans">
      <main className="w-full px-3.5 sm:px-4 pt-4 pb-24">
        
        {/* Top Control Bar */}
        <section aria-label="Search and Filters" className="w-full">
          {/* Simplified Filter Pills Row: All, Online, Near Me, New */}
          <div
            ref={pillTrackRef}
            onMouseDown={handlePillMouseDown}
            onMouseLeave={handlePillMouseUp}
            onMouseUp={handlePillMouseUp}
            onMouseMove={handlePillMouseMove}
            onWheel={handlePillWheel}
            className="w-full mb-4 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar touch-pan-x select-none"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-max">
                {/* Compact Search + Gear Pills */}
                {searchOpen || searchQuery ? (
                  <div className="shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1 bg-white border border-[#DDD7E5] focus-within:border-[#6555B8] rounded-full pl-3 pr-1.5 py-1.5 shadow-xs">
                    <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#8C849B] shrink-0 pointer-events-none" />
                    <input
                      autoFocus
                      type="text"
                      value={searchQuery}
                      onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                      
                      placeholder="City or username"
                      aria-label="Search"
                      className="w-28 sm:w-36 bg-transparent px-1 text-xs text-[#1C1924] placeholder-[#8C849B] focus:outline-none"
                    />
                    {searchQuery ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => { setSearchQuery(''); setSearchOpen(false); }}
                        className="text-[#8C849B] hover:text-[#1C1924] text-xs px-1"
                        aria-label="Clear search"
                      >
                        Clear
                      </button>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="shrink-0 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setSearchOpen(true)}
                      aria-label="Open Search"
                      className="p-2 rounded-full bg-white border border-[#DDD7E5] text-[#8C849B] hover:text-[#6555B8] hover:border-[#CFC8DC] transition shadow-xs"
                    >
                      <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setFiltersOpen(true)}
                      aria-label="Open Filters"
                      className="relative p-2 rounded-full bg-white border border-[#DDD7E5] text-[#6555B8] hover:border-[#CFC8DC] transition shadow-xs"
                    >
                      <SlidersHorizontal className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      {activeFiltersCount > 0 && (
                        <span className="absolute -top-0.5 -right-0.5 w-3.5 h-3.5 bg-[#6555B8] text-white text-[9px] font-bold rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
                          {activeFiltersCount}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
              {DISCOVERY_MODES.map((mode) => {
                const active = discoveryMode === mode.id;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={mode.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (!pillDraggedRef.current) setDiscoveryMode(mode.id);
                    }}
                    className={
                      'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold border transition-all whitespace-nowrap active:scale-95 cursor-pointer ' +
                      (active
                        ? 'bg-[#6555B8] border-[#6555B8] text-white'
                        : 'bg-white border-[#DDD7E5] text-[#524B5E] hover:border-[#6555B8]/40 hover:text-[#1C1924]')
                    }
                  >
                    {mode.label}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* 2-Column Mobile Feed Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 w-full">
          {isLoading ? (
            Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, i) => (
              <div
                key={i}
                className="rounded-2xl overflow-hidden aspect-[4/5] w-full bg-[#EAE8F0] animate-pulse border border-[#DDD7E5] relative"
              >
                <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 p-3 space-y-2">
                  <div className="h-4 bg-white/40 rounded-full w-2/3" />
                  <div className="h-3 bg-white/30 rounded-full w-1/2" />
                </div>
              </div>
            ))
          ) : (
            visibleProfiles.map((profile) => {
              const state = cardActions[profile.id];
              const isLiked = state === 'like';
              const isStarred = false;
              const displayName = profile.username || profile.name || 'Member';
              const sharedCount = computeSharedCount(profile);
              const cityPart = profile.location ? profile.location.split(',')[0].trim() : '';
              const countryPart = profile.country || '';
              const formattedLocation =
                cityPart && countryPart && cityPart.toLowerCase() !== countryPart.toLowerCase()
                  ? `${cityPart}, ${countryPart}`
                  : cityPart || countryPart || 'Unknown';

              return (
                <div
                  key={profile.id}
                  className="group relative rounded-2xl overflow-hidden aspect-[4/5] w-full bg-[#F2EEF7] border border-[#DDD7E5]/60 shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300 select-none"
                >
                  <DiscoverCardPhotoCarousel
                    profileId={profile.id}
                    photos={profile.photos}
                    avatarUrl={profile.avatarUrl}
                    name={displayName}
                    repScore={profile.repScore}
                    sharedCount={sharedCount}
                    online={profile.online}
                    recentlyActive={profile.recentlyActive}
                  />

                  {/* Send Spark - small zap, bottom-left */}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={isLiked ? 'Remove Spark' : 'Send Spark'}
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      e.preventDefault();
                      triggerAction(profile.id, 'like', displayName, profile.avatarUrl);
                    }}
                    className={
                      'absolute top-2 right-2 z-20 w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-200 active:scale-90 cursor-pointer ' +
                      (isLiked
                        ? 'bg-[#6555B8] text-white shadow-md'
                        : 'bg-black/45 text-white hover:bg-black/65 backdrop-blur-xs')
                    }
                  >
                    <Zap className={'w-4 h-4 ' + (isLiked ? 'fill-white' : '')} />
                  </button>

                  {/* Subtle Bottom-Only Gradient with Full-Width Non-Overlapping Text */}
                  <div className="absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 pt-10 pb-2.5 px-3 z-10 pointer-events-none bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 via-black/25 to-transparent">
                    <Link href={'/profile/' + profile.id} className="block min-w-0 pointer-events-auto">
                      {/* Line 1: Name + Age + Verified Check */}
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 min-w-0">
                        <h3
                          className="text-sm font-bold text-white leading-tight truncate"
                          style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-brand)' }}
                        >
                          {displayName}
                        </h3>
                        {profile.age ? (
                          <span
                            className="text-sm font-bold text-white leading-tight shrink-0"
                            style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-brand)' }}
                          >
                            , {profile.age}
                          </span>
                        ) : null}
                        {profile.verified && (
                          <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white shrink-0 ml-0.5" />
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Line 2: Location (City, Country) */}
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-white/90 font-medium mt-0.5 truncate">
                        {formattedLocation}
                      </p>


                    </Link>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>

        {!isLoading && filteredProfiles.length === 0 && (
          <div className="mt-4 p-8 rounded-2xl bg-white border border-[#DDD7E5] text-center space-y-3 shadow-xs">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto rounded-2xl bg-[#F3EFFC] flex items-center justify-center text-[#6555B8]">
              <Search className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <p
              className="text-base font-bold text-[#1C1924]"
              style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-brand)' }}
            >
              No profiles match your current filters
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#6C637B] max-w-xs mx-auto leading-relaxed">
              Tap below to reset your filters to your saved preference ({viewerSavedGenders.map((g) => GENDER_LABELS[g] || g).join(', ') || 'All'}), or open Filters to adjust who you are looking for.
            </p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={resetFilters}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-full bg-[#6555B8] text-white hover:bg-[#52449e] transition shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Reset Filters</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {

function DiscoverFeed() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<div className="min-h-screen bg-[#F8F7FA] text-[#1C1924] p-8 text-center text-xs">Loading discover feed...</div>}>
      <DiscoverContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
function AuthGate() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [authState, setAuthState] = useState<'loading' | 'member'>('loading');
  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    supabase.auth.getUser().then(({ data }) => {
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (data?.user) {
        setAuthState('member');
      } else {
        router.replace('/');
      }
    });
    return () => { mounted = false; };
  }, [router]);

  if (authState === 'loading') {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#0d0b14] flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-4 border-[#6555B8] border-t-transparent"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return <DiscoverFeed />;
}

export default AuthGate;

'use client';


import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Heart, MapPin, CheckCircle, ShieldCheck, Loader2, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase/client';

interface FavoriteProfile {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  age?: number;
  location?: string;
  location_source?: string;
  verified?: boolean;
  repScore?: number;
  avatarUrl?: string;
  photoUrl?: string;
}

export default function FavoritesPage() {
  const [favorites, setFavorites] = useState<FavoriteProfile[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [userId, setUserId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadFavorites() {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
        if (!user) {
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        setUserId(user.id);

        const { data: favRecords, error: favErr } = await supabase
          .from('favorites')
          .select('favorite_profile_id')
          .eq('user_id', user.id);

        if (favErr) throw favErr;

        if (!favRecords || favRecords.length === 0) {
          setFavorites([]);
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }

        const profileIds = favRecords.map((r: { favorite_profile_id: string }) => r.favorite_profile_id);

        const { data: profs, error: profErr } = await supabase
          .from('profiles')
          .select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url, photos, reputation_score, age, city, country, location_source, is_verified')
          .in('id', profileIds);

        if (profErr) throw profErr;

        const mapped: FavoriteProfile[] = (profs || []).map((p: any) => {
          const rawName = p.username || p.display_name || 'Member';
          const cleanName = rawName.startsWith('user_') ? 'Member' : rawName;
          const firstPhoto = Array.isArray(p.photos) && p.photos.length > 0 ? p.photos[0] : (p.avatar_url || '/placeholder-avatar.svg');

          return {
            id: p.id,
            name: cleanName,
            age: p.age,
            location: [p.city, p.country].filter(Boolean).join(', ') || 'Global',
            location_source: p.location_source,
            verified: p.is_verified ?? false,
            repScore: p.reputation_score || 98,
            avatarUrl: p.avatar_url || '/placeholder-avatar.svg',
            photoUrl: firstPhoto,
          };
        });

        setFavorites(mapped);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error loading favorites:', err instanceof Error ? err.message : JSON.stringify(err, Object.getOwnPropertyNames(err)));
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }

    loadFavorites();
  }, []);

  const handleRemoveFavorite = async (profileId: string) => {
    if (!userId) return;

    setFavorites((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== profileId));

    try {
      await supabase
        .from('favorites')
        .delete()
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .eq('favorite_profile_id', profileId);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to remove favorite:', err);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-[#F8F7FA] text-[#1C1924]">      <main className="flex-1 max-w-5xl mx-auto w-full px-4 sm:px-6 pt-6 pb-32 md:pb-24 space-y-5">
      

      {/* Main Content Area */}
      {loading ? (
        <div className="py-24 text-center space-y-3">
          <Loader2 className="w-7 h-7 text-[#6555b8] animate-spin mx-auto" />
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#756D82]">Loading your saved profiles...</p>
        </div>
      ) : favorites.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-16 sm:py-24 text-center">
          <div className="space-y-4 max-w-sm mx-auto">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-[#F0EBF8] text-[#6555b8] flex items-center justify-center mx-auto transition-transform">
              <Sparkles className="w-6 h-6" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-medium text-[#1C1924]">No saved profiles yet</h2>
              <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#756D82] leading-relaxed">
                When you discover someone who stands out, tap the bookmark or heart on their profile to save them here.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="pt-2">
              <Link
                href="/discover"
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center px-6 py-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#6555b8] hover:bg-[#52449e] text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold text-white transition active:scale-95 shadow-sm"
              >
                Explore Discover Feed
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5 sm:gap-4 lg:gap-5 w-full">
          {favorites.map((profile) => (
            <div
              key={profile.id}
              className="group relative rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl overflow-hidden bg-white border border-[#E5E1EC] hover:border-[#6555b8]/35 shadow-xs hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200 flex flex-col justify-between"
            >
              {/* Photo Container */}
              <div className="relative w-full aspect-[4/5] overflow-hidden bg-[#F2EEF7]">
                <Link href={'/profile/' + profile.id} className="absolute inset-0 z-0">
                  <img
                    src={profile.photoUrl}
                    alt={profile.name}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300"
                  />
                </Link>

                {/* Reputation Badge */}
                {profile.repScore !== undefined && (
                  <div className="absolute top-2.5 left-2.5 z-10 flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-black/55 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 text-[10px] font-semibold text-[#E5DEFF]">
                    <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-[#A78BFA] shrink-0" />
                    <span>{profile.repScore}%</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Gradient for bottom action button */}
                <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-16 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 to-transparent pointer-events-none" />

                {/* Un-favorite Button */}
                <div className="absolute bottom-2.5 right-2.5 z-20">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label="Remove from saved"
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      e.preventDefault();
                      handleRemoveFavorite(profile.id);
                    }}
                    className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center bg-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-600 border border-rose-400 text-white shadow-md transition-all active:scale-90"
                    title="Remove from bookmarks"
                  >
                    <Heart className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-5 sm:h-5 fill-white" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Profile Details */}
              <div className="p-3.5 sm:p-4 bg-white">
                <Link href={'/profile/' + profile.id} className="block group-hover:opacity-95">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1">
                    <h3 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-medium text-[#1C1924] flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate">
                      {profile.name}{profile.age ? `, ${profile.age}` : ''}
                      {profile.verified && <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#6555b8] shrink-0" />}
                    </h3>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-medium text-[#756D82] flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate">
                    <MapPin
                      className={'w-3 h-3 shrink-0 ' + (
                        profile.location_source === 'gps_verified' ? 'text-emerald-500' : 'text-[#8C849B]'
                      )}
                    />
                    <span className="truncate">{profile.location ? profile.location.split(',')[0] : 'Unknown'}</span>
                  </p>
                </Link>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </main>
  </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Mail, ArrowLeft, CheckCircle2, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react';

export default function ForgotPasswordPage() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [isSubmitted, setIsSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!email.trim()) return;

    setIsLoading(true);
    // Simulate auth recovery dispatch
    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setIsSubmitted(true);
    }, 700);
  };

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#F8F7FA] text-[#1C1924] flex flex-col justify-center px-4 py-12">
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm mx-auto bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#9A8CC3]/35 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl">

          Back to Login
        </Link>

        {isSubmitted ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center space-y-3">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-7 h-7" />
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-medium text-[#1C1924]">Reset Link Sent</h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-[#1C1924] leading-relaxed">
              If an account is associated with <span className="text-[#1C1924] font-medium">{email}</span>, you will receive a secure password recovery link shortly.

            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#9A8CC3]/30 text-xs text-[#1C1924] text-left leading-normal w-full mt-2">
              <span className="font-semibold text-[#1C1924] block mb-0.5">Check Your Junk Folder</span>
              Security emails sometimes filter into spam or promotions tabs. Please check there if nothing arrives within 2 minutes.
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setIsSubmitted(false)}
              className="mt-4 text-xs font-semibold text-[#9A8CC3] hover:text-[#1C1924] transition"
            >
              Try another email
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex flex-col space-y-4">
            <div className="flex flex-col space-y-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-[#9A8CC3]" />
                <h1 className="text-xl font-medium text-[#1C1924]">Reset Your Password</h1>
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm text-[#1C1924] leading-relaxed">
                Enter your account email address and we will dispatch a confidential reset link.
              </p>

import { useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { createBrowserClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { Eye, EyeOff, Loader2, LogIn } from "lucide-react";

export default function LoginPage() {
  const [supabase] = useState(() =>
    createBrowserClient(
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!
    )
  );
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [googleLoading, setGoogleLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function handleGoogleSignIn() {
    setGoogleLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
      provider: "google",
      options: { redirectTo: `${window.location.origin}/auth/callback` },
    });
    if (error) {
      setError(error.message);
      setGoogleLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleEmailSignIn(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!email || !password) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });
    if (error) {
      setError(
        error.message === "Invalid login credentials"
          ? "Incorrect email or password. Please try again."
          : error.message
      );
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    if (data?.user) {
      const { data: profile } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .select("onboarding_completed")
        .eq("id", data.user.id)
        .maybeSingle();

      window.location.href = profile?.onboarding_completed ? "/discover" : "/onboarding";
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#FAF9FD] flex flex-col font-sans antialiased selection:bg-[#6555b8]/15 selection:text-[#6555b8]">
      {/* Mobile-First App Shell — matches homepage */}
      <main className="flex-1 w-full max-w-md mx-auto bg-white min-h-screen px-6 pt-12 pb-8 flex flex-col justify-center sm:my-6 sm:rounded-3xl sm:border sm:border-[#EDE8F5] sm:shadow-xl sm:p-8 sm:min-h-0">

        {/* Heading only — header owns the branding */}
        <div className="mb-10 text-center">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-[#181126]">Welcome back</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-[#756D82]">
            Sign in to continue your journey.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Google Sign-In */}
        <button
          onClick={handleGoogleSignIn}
          disabled={googleLoading}
          className="w-full py-3.5 px-6 rounded-full bg-white border border-[#EDE8F5] text-[#181126] text-sm font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5 shadow-sm hover:bg-[#FAF9FD] active:scale-[0.99] transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
        >
          {googleLoading ? (
            <Loader2 className="w-4.5 h-4.5 animate-spin text-[#6555b8]" />
          ) : (
            <svg className="w-4.5 h-4.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
              <path fill="#4285F4" d="M23.49 12.27c0-.79-.07-1.54-.19-2.27H12v4.51h6.47c-.29 1.48-1.14 2.73-2.4 3.58v3h3.86c2.26-2.09 3.56-5.17 3.56-8.82z" />
              <path fill="#34A853" d="M12 24c3.24 0 5.95-1.08 7.93-2.91l-3.86-3c-1.08.72-2.45 1.16-4.07 1.16-3.13 0-5.78-2.11-6.73-4.96H1.29v3.09C3.26 21.3 7.31 24 12 24z" />
              <path fill="#FBBC05" d="M5.27 14.29c-.25-.72-.38-1.49-.38-2.29s.14-1.57.38-2.29V6.62H1.29C.47 8.24 0 10.06 0 12s.47 3.76 1.29 5.38l3.98-3.09z" />
              <path fill="#EA4335" d="M12 4.75c1.77 0 3.35.61 4.6 1.8l3.42-3.42C17.95 1.19 15.24 0 12 0 7.31 0 3.26 2.7 1.29 6.62l3.98 3.09C6.22 6.86 8.87 4.75 12 4.75z" />
            </svg>
          )}
          <span>{googleLoading ? "Redirecting..." : "Continue with Google"}</span>
        </button>

        {/* Divider */}
        <div className="my-6 flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex-1 h-px bg-[#EDE8F5]" />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#CBC4DA]">
            or with email
          </span>
          <div className="flex-1 h-px bg-[#EDE8F5]" />
        </div>

        {/* Email Sign-In Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleEmailSignIn} className="space-y-3.5">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label htmlFor="email" className="text-xs font-bold text-[#4A4458] block">
              Email address
            </label>
            <input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              autoComplete="email"
              required
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="you@example.com"
              className="w-full py-3.5 px-4 rounded-2xl bg-white border border-[#EDE8F5] text-sm text-[#181126] placeholder:text-[#CBC4DA] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#6555b8] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#6555b8]/15 transition"
            />

          {/* Error Message */}
          {error && (
