function DiscoverCardPhotoCarousel({
  profileId,
  photos,
  avatarUrl,
  name,
  repScore,
  sharedCount,
  online,
  recentlyActive,
}: DiscoverCardPhotoCarouselProps) {
  const [currentIdx, setCurrentIdx] = useState(0);

  const rawList = (photos && photos.length > 0 ? photos : [avatarUrl]).filter(
    (p): p is string => typeof p === 'string' && p.trim().length > 0 && p !== '/placeholder-avatar.svg'
  );
  const uniqueList = Array.from(new Set(rawList));
  const displayPhotos = uniqueList.length > 0 ? uniqueList : [avatarUrl || '/placeholder-avatar.svg'];
  const hasMultiple = displayPhotos.length > 1;

  const handlePrev = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setCurrentIdx((prev) => (prev === 0 ? displayPhotos.length - 1 : prev - 1));
  };

  const handleNext = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setCurrentIdx((prev) => (prev === displayPhotos.length - 1 ? 0 : prev + 1));
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative block h-full w-full overflow-hidden bg-[#F2EEF7] select-none">
      <Link href={'/profile/' + profileId} className="absolute inset-0 z-0">
        <img
          src={displayPhotos[currentIdx]}
          alt={name}
          className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-[1.03] transition-transform duration-500 ease-out"
          loading="lazy"
        />
      </Link>

      {hasMultiple && (
        <div className="absolute top-2 inset-x-2.5 z-20 flex gap-1 pointer-events-none">
          {displayPhotos.map((_, i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              className={
                'h-1 flex-1 rounded-full transition-all duration-200 ' +
                (i === currentIdx ? 'bg-white shadow-xs' : 'bg-white/35 backdrop-blur-xs')
              }
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Fixed Top-Left Consistent Reputation Pill */}
      <div
        className={
          'absolute ' +
          (hasMultiple ? 'top-4' : 'top-2.5') +
          ' left-2.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 z-20 pointer-events-none'
        }
      >
        <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xs text-[10px] font-medium text-white">
          <span>{repScore ? repScore + '% Rep' : '100% Rep'}</span>
        </div>

        {online ? (
          <span className="presence-dot h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 ring-2 ring-white/90 shadow-xs shrink-0" />
        ) : recentlyActive ? (
          <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 ring-1.5 ring-white/80 shadow-xs shrink-0" />
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {/* Split-Touch Photo Carousel Zones */}
      {hasMultiple && (
        <>
          <div
            onClick={handlePrev}
            className="absolute top-12 bottom-20 left-0 w-1/2 z-10 cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Previous photo"
          />
          <div
            onClick={handleNext}
            className="absolute top-12 bottom-20 right-0 w-1/2 z-10 cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Next photo"
          />
        </>
      )}

      {hasMultiple && (
        <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center justify-between absolute inset-x-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-20 pointer-events-none opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-200">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handlePrev}
            className="pointer-events-auto p-1.5 rounded-full bg-black/40 hover:bg-black/70 text-white backdrop-blur-xs transition active:scale-90"
            aria-label="Previous photo"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleNext}
            className="pointer-events-auto p-1.5 rounded-full bg-black/40 hover:bg-black/70 text-white backdrop-blur-xs transition active:scale-90"
            aria-label="Next photo"
          >
            <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function normalizeGenderValue(raw?: string | null): 'woman' | 'man' | 'trans_woman' | 'trans_man' | 'non_binary' {
  const val = String(raw || '').toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[\s-]+/g, '_');
  if (['man', 'men', 'male', 'm', 'guy', 'guys'].includes(val)) return 'man';
  if (['woman', 'women', 'female', 'f', 'lady', 'ladies', 'girl', 'girls'].includes(val)) return 'woman';
  if (['trans_woman', 'trans_women', 'transgender_woman', 'transgender_women', 'trans', 'mtf', 'transfemale'].includes(val)) return 'trans_woman';
  if (['trans_man', 'trans_men', 'transgender_man', 'transgender_men', 'ftm', 'transmale'].includes(val)) return 'trans_man';
  if (['non_binary', 'nonbinary', 'nb', 'enby'].includes(val)) return 'non_binary';
  return 'woman';
}

function formatConciseIntent(raw?: string | null): string {
  if (!raw) return 'Serious Relationship';
  const cleaned = raw.trim();
  if (cleaned.length <= 24) return cleaned;
  const lower = cleaned.toLowerCase();
  if (lower.includes('marriage') && lower.includes('kids')) return 'Marriage & Kids';
  if (lower.includes('marriage')) return 'Marriage-Minded';
  if (lower.includes('serious') || lower.includes('long-term') || lower.includes('long term')) return 'Long-Term Partner';
  if (lower.includes('life partner')) return 'Life Partner';
  const words = cleaned.split(/\s+/);
  let acc = '';
  for (const w of words) {
    if ((acc + ' ' + w).trim().length > 24) break;
    acc = (acc + ' ' + w).trim();
  }
  return acc || cleaned.slice(0, 22);
}

function DiscoverContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const [discoveryMode, setDiscoveryMode] = useState<DiscoveryModeId>('all');

  const pillTrackRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const pillIsDraggingRef = useRef(false);
  const pillStartXRef = useRef(0);
  const pillScrollLeftRef = useRef(0);
  const pillDraggedRef = useRef(false);

  const handlePillMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    const slider = pillTrackRef.current;
    if (!slider) return;
    pillIsDraggingRef.current = true;
    pillDraggedRef.current = false;
    pillStartXRef.current = e.pageX - slider.offsetLeft;
    pillScrollLeftRef.current = slider.scrollLeft;
  };

  const handlePillMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (!pillIsDraggingRef.current || !pillTrackRef.current) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const slider = pillTrackRef.current;
    const x = e.pageX - slider.offsetLeft;
    const walk = (x - pillStartXRef.current) * 1.3;
    if (Math.abs(walk) > 4) {
      pillDraggedRef.current = true;
    }
    slider.scrollLeft = pillScrollLeftRef.current - walk;
  };

  const handlePillMouseUp = () => {
    pillIsDraggingRef.current = false;
    setTimeout(() => {
      pillDraggedRef.current = false;
    }, 60);
  };

  const handlePillWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent) => {
    const slider = pillTrackRef.current;
    if (!slider) return;
    if (e.deltaY !== 0) {
      slider.scrollLeft += e.deltaY;
    }
  };

  const [currentUserCoords, setCurrentUserCoords] = useState<{ lat: number; lon: number } | null>(null);
  const [viewerInterests, setViewerInterests] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [viewerIntent, setViewerIntent] = useState<string>('');
  const [viewerSavedGenders, setViewerSavedGenders] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState<ProfileItem[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState(() => searchParams.get('q') || '');
  const [selectedCountry, setSelectedCountry] = useState(() => {
    const c = searchParams.get('country');
    return c && c.toLowerCase() !== 'all' ? c : 'All';
  });

  const userSelectedGenderManually = useRef(Boolean(searchParams.get('gender')));
  const [selectedGenders, setSelectedGenders] = useState<string[]>(() => {
    const g = searchParams.get('gender');
    if (!g || g.toLowerCase() === 'all') return [];
    return g.split(',').map((s) => normalizeGenderValue(s));
  });

  const toggleGender = (gender: string) => {
    userSelectedGenderManually.current = true;
    setSelectedGenders((prev) =>
      prev.includes(gender) ? prev.filter((g) => g !== gender) : [...prev, gender]
    );
  };

  const [filtersOpen, setFiltersOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isCountryOpen, setIsCountryOpen] = useState(false);
  const countryDropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  const [minAge, setMinAge] = useState<number>(() => {
    const val = Number(searchParams.get('minAge'));
    return !isNaN(val) && val >= 18 && val <= 80 ? val : 18;
  });
  const [maxAge, setMaxAge] = useState<number>(() => {
    const val = Number(searchParams.get('maxAge'));
    return !isNaN(val) && val >= 18 && val <= 80 ? val : 65;
  });
  const [draftMinAge, setDraftMinAge] = useState<number>(minAge);
  const [draftMaxAge, setDraftMaxAge] = useState<number>(maxAge);

  const [selectedIntent, setSelectedIntent] = useState<string>(() => searchParams.get('intent') || 'All');
  const [verifiedOnly, setVerifiedOnly] = useState<boolean>(() => searchParams.get('verified') === 'true');
  const [activeNowOnly, setActiveNowOnly] = useState<boolean>(() => searchParams.get('active') === 'true');

  const [matchedModalProfile, setMatchedModalProfile] = useState<{ id: string; name: string; avatarUrl?: string } | null>(null);
  const [isModalClosing, setIsModalClosing] = useState(false);
  const [cardActions, setCardActions] = useState<Record<string, ActionType>>({});
  const [lastPassed, setLastPassed] = useState<{ id: string; name: string } | null>(null);

  const BATCH_SIZE = 12;
  const [visibleLimit, setVisibleLimit] = useState(BATCH_SIZE);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (filtersOpen) {
      setDraftMinAge(minAge);
      setDraftMaxAge(maxAge);
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    };
  }, [filtersOpen, minAge, maxAge]);

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event: MouseEvent) {
      if (countryDropdownRef.current && !countryDropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsCountryOpen(false);
      }
    }
    if (isCountryOpen) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    }
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, [isCountryOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMutualMatch = (e: CustomEvent<{ targetId: string }>) => {
      const target = profiles.find((p) => p.id === e.detail.targetId);
      if (target) {
        playMatchChime();
        setMatchedModalProfile({
          id: target.id,
          name: target.name,
          avatarUrl: target.avatarUrl,
        });
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('ail-mutual-match' as any, handleMutualMatch);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('ail-mutual-match' as any, handleMutualMatch);
  }, [profiles]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const local = getLocalCardActions();
    setCardActions(local);

    async function loadFeed() {
      setIsLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/discover', { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (res.ok) {
          const payload = await res.json();
          const v = payload.viewer;

          if (v) {
            if (v.onboarding_completed === false) {
              router.push('/onboarding');
              return;
            }
            if (v.latitude && v.longitude) {
              setCurrentUserCoords({ lat: v.latitude, lon: v.longitude });
            }
            if (Array.isArray(v.interests)) {
              setViewerInterests(v.interests);
            }
            if (v.intent) {
              setViewerIntent(v.intent);
            }
            if (Array.isArray(v.interested_in) && v.interested_in.length > 0) {
              setViewerSavedGenders(v.interested_in);
              if (!userSelectedGenderManually.current) {
                setSelectedGenders(v.interested_in);
              }
            }
          }

          if (Array.isArray(payload.favoriteIds)) {
            setCardActions((prev) => {
              const merged = { ...prev };
              payload.favoriteIds.forEach((fid: string) => {
                merged[fid] = 'like';
              });
              return merged;
            });
          }

          if (Array.isArray(payload.profiles)) {
            setProfiles(payload.profiles);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to load discovery profiles:', err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }

    loadFeed();
  }, [router]);

  const computeSharedCount = (profile: ProfileItem): number => {
    let count = 0;
    if (viewerInterests.length > 0 && Array.isArray(profile.interests)) {
      const viewerSet = new Set(viewerInterests.map((i) => i.toLowerCase()));
      profile.interests.forEach((tag) => {
        if (viewerSet.has(tag.toLowerCase())) count++;
      });
    }
    if (viewerIntent && profile.intent && viewerIntent.toLowerCase() === profile.intent.toLowerCase()) {
      count++;
    }
    return count;
  };

  const closeModalWithAnimation = () => {
    setIsModalClosing(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setMatchedModalProfile(null);
      setIsModalClosing(false);
    }, 220);
  };

  const triggerAction = async (id: string, action: ActionType, name?: string, avatarUrl?: string) => {
    const currentAction = cardActions[id];
    const isCurrentlyActive = currentAction === action;

    setCardActions((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      if (isCurrentlyActive) {
        delete next[id];
      } else {
        next[id] = action;
      }
      return next;
    });

    if (action === 'pass' && !isCurrentlyActive && name) {
      setLastPassed({ id, name });
    } else if (lastPassed?.id === id) {
      setLastPassed(null);
    }

    await persistCardAction(supabase, id, action, isCurrentlyActive);

    if (action === 'like' && !isCurrentlyActive) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/spark', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ targetUserId: id }),
        });
        const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        if (data?.mutual) {
          playMatchChime();
          setMatchedModalProfile({
            id,
            name: name || 'Member',
            avatarUrl: avatarUrl || '/placeholder-avatar.svg',
          });
        }
      } catch {
        // Non-blocking spark check
      }
    }
  };

  const undoLastPass = () => {
    if (!lastPassed) return;
    const targetId = lastPassed.id;
    setCardActions((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      delete next[targetId];
      return next;
    });
    persistCardAction(supabase, targetId, 'pass', true);
    setLastPassed(null);
  };

  const activeFiltersCount = useMemo(() => {
    let count = 0;
    if (selectedCountry.toLowerCase() !== 'all') count++;
    if (minAge > 18 || maxAge < 65) count++;
    if (selectedIntent !== 'All') count++;
    if (verifiedOnly) count++;
    if (activeNowOnly) count++;
    if (discoveryMode !== 'all') count++;
    return count;
  }, [selectedCountry, minAge, maxAge, selectedIntent, verifiedOnly, activeNowOnly, discoveryMode]);

  const applyFilters = () => {
    setMinAge(draftMinAge);
    setMaxAge(draftMaxAge);
    setFiltersOpen(false);
  };

  const resetFilters = () => {
    setDiscoveryMode('all');
    setSelectedGenders(viewerSavedGenders.length > 0 ? viewerSavedGenders : []);
    setSelectedCountry('All');
    setSearchQuery('');
    setMinAge(18);
    setMaxAge(65);
    setDraftMinAge(18);
    setDraftMaxAge(65);
    setSelectedIntent('All');
    setVerifiedOnly(false);
    setActiveNowOnly(false);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        localStorage.removeItem('ail_passed_ids');
      } catch {}
    }
    setCardActions((prev) => {
      const cleaned: Record<string, ActionType> = {};
      Object.entries(prev).forEach(([k, v]) => {
        if (v !== 'pass') cleaned[k] = v;
      });
      return cleaned;
    });
  };

  const filteredProfiles = useMemo(() => {
    const base = profiles.filter((profile) => {
      if (cardActions[profile.id] === 'pass') return false;

      const matchesCountry =
        selectedCountry.toLowerCase() === 'all' ||
        (profile.country || '').toLowerCase() === selectedCountry.toLowerCase();

      const matchesGender =
        selectedGenders.length === 0 || selectedGenders.includes(profile.gender);

      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      const matchesQuery =
        !q ||
        profile.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        profile.location.toLowerCase().includes(q);

      const matchesAge = profile.age >= minAge && profile.age <= maxAge;
      const matchesIntent =
        selectedIntent === 'All' || !profile.intent || profile.intent === selectedIntent;
      const matchesVerified = !verifiedOnly || profile.verified;
      const matchesOnline = !activeNowOnly || profile.online;

      const matchesDiscoveryMode = (() => {
        if (discoveryMode === 'online') {
          return Boolean(profile.online || profile.recentlyActive);
        }
        if (discoveryMode === 'near_me') {
          if (currentUserCoords && profile.latitude && profile.longitude) {
            const R = 6371;
            const dLat = ((profile.latitude - currentUserCoords.lat) * Math.PI) / 180;
            const dLon = ((profile.longitude - currentUserCoords.lon) * Math.PI) / 180;
            const a =
              Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
              Math.cos((currentUserCoords.lat * Math.PI) / 180) *
                Math.cos((profile.latitude * Math.PI) / 180) *
                Math.sin(dLon / 2) *
                Math.sin(dLon / 2);
            const distKm = R * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
            return distKm <= 500;
          }
          return true;
        }
        if (discoveryMode === 'new') {
          const createdAt = profile.created_at ? new Date(profile.created_at).getTime() : 0;
          return createdAt > Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
        }
        return true;
      })();

      return (
        matchesCountry &&
        matchesGender &&
        matchesQuery &&
        matchesAge &&
        matchesIntent &&
        matchesVerified &&
        matchesOnline &&
        matchesDiscoveryMode
      );
    });

    if (discoveryMode === 'new') {
      return [...base].sort((a, b) => {
        const tA = a.created_at ? new Date(a.created_at).getTime() : 0;
        const tB = b.created_at ? new Date(b.created_at).getTime() : 0;
        return tB - tA;
      });
    }
    return base;
  }, [
    profiles,
    cardActions,
    selectedCountry,
    selectedGenders,
    searchQuery,
    minAge,
    maxAge,
    selectedIntent,
    verifiedOnly,
    activeNowOnly,
    discoveryMode,
    currentUserCoords,
  ]);

  const visibleProfiles = filteredProfiles.slice(0, visibleLimit);
  const hasMore = visibleLimit < filteredProfiles.length;

  return (
    <div className="w-full min-h-full bg-[#F8F7FA] text-[#1C1924] flex flex-col font-sans">
      <main className="w-full px-3.5 sm:px-4 pt-4 pb-24">
        
        {/* Top Control Bar */}
        <section aria-label="Search and Filters" className="w-full">
          {/* Search Bar */}
          <div className="w-full mb-4 bg-white border border-[#DDD7E5] hover:border-[#CFC8DC] focus-within:border-[#6555B8] focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-[#6555B8]/15 rounded-full shadow-2xs transition-all flex items-center pl-3.5 pr-1.5 py-1.5">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-[#8C849B] shrink-0 pointer-events-none" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search city, username..."
              className="w-full bg-transparent px-2 text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#1C1924] placeholder-[#8C849B] focus:outline-none min-w-0"
            />
            {searchQuery && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                className="text-[#8C849B] hover:text-[#1C1924] text-xs px-1.5 py-0.5 shrink-0"
              >
                Clear
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                setFiltersOpen(true);
              }}
              aria-label="Open Filters"
              className="relative p-1.5 rounded-full text-[#6555B8] hover:bg-[#F3EFFC] transition shrink-0 ml-1"
            >
              <SlidersHorizontal className="w-4 h-4" />
              {activeFiltersCount > 0 && (
                <span className="absolute -top-0.5 -right-0.5 w-3.5 h-3.5 bg-[#6555B8] text-white text-[9px] font-bold rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
                  {activeFiltersCount}
                </span>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Simplified Filter Pills Row: All, Online, Near Me, New */}
          <div
            ref={pillTrackRef}
            onMouseDown={handlePillMouseDown}
            onMouseLeave={handlePillMouseUp}
            onMouseUp={handlePillMouseUp}
            onMouseMove={handlePillMouseMove}
            onWheel={handlePillWheel}
            className="w-full mb-4 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar touch-pan-x select-none"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-max">
              {DISCOVERY_MODES.map((mode) => {
                const active = discoveryMode === mode.id;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={mode.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (!pillDraggedRef.current) setDiscoveryMode(mode.id);
                    }}
                    className={
                      'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold border transition-all whitespace-nowrap active:scale-95 cursor-pointer ' +
                      (active
                        ? 'bg-[#6555B8] border-[#6555B8] text-white'
                        : 'bg-white border-[#DDD7E5] text-[#524B5E] hover:border-[#6555B8]/40 hover:text-[#1C1924]')
                    }
                  >
                    {mode.label}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* 2-Column Mobile Feed Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 sm:gap-3 w-full">
          {isLoading ? (
            Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, i) => (
              <div
                key={i}
                className="rounded-2xl overflow-hidden aspect-[4/5] w-full bg-[#EAE8F0] animate-pulse border border-[#DDD7E5] relative"
              >
                <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 p-3 space-y-2">
                  <div className="h-4 bg-white/40 rounded-full w-2/3" />
                  <div className="h-3 bg-white/30 rounded-full w-1/2" />
                </div>
              </div>
            ))
          ) : (
            visibleProfiles.map((profile) => {
              const state = cardActions[profile.id];
              const isLiked = state === 'like';
              const isStarred = false;
              const displayName = profile.username || profile.name || 'Member';
              const sharedCount = computeSharedCount(profile);
              const cityPart = profile.location ? profile.location.split(',')[0].trim() : '';
              const countryPart = profile.country || '';
              const formattedLocation =
                cityPart && countryPart && cityPart.toLowerCase() !== countryPart.toLowerCase()
                  ? `${cityPart}, ${countryPart}`
                  : cityPart || countryPart || 'Unknown';
              const conciseGoal = formatConciseIntent(profile.intent || profile.looking_for);

              return (
                <div
                  key={profile.id}
                  className="group relative rounded-2xl overflow-hidden aspect-[4/5] w-full bg-[#F2EEF7] border border-[#DDD7E5]/60 shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300 select-none"
                >
                  <DiscoverCardPhotoCarousel
                    profileId={profile.id}
                    photos={profile.photos}
                    avatarUrl={profile.avatarUrl}
                    name={displayName}
                    repScore={profile.repScore}
                    sharedCount={sharedCount}
                    online={profile.online}
                    recentlyActive={profile.recentlyActive}
                  />

                  {/* Top-Right Action Icons (44x44px touch targets, completely clear of bottom text gradient) */}
                  <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 z-20 flex flex-col gap-1.5 pointer-events-auto">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      aria-label={isLiked ? 'Unlike' : 'Like'}
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        e.preventDefault();
                        triggerAction(profile.id, 'like', displayName, profile.avatarUrl);
                      }}
                      className={
                        'w-11 h-11 min-w-[44px] min-h-[44px] rounded-full flex items-center justify-center border transition-all duration-200 active:scale-90 backdrop-blur-xs select-none cursor-pointer ' +
                        (isLiked
                          ? 'bg-[#6555B8] border-[#6555B8] text-white shadow-md'
                          : 'bg-black/35 hover:bg-black/55 border-white/25 text-white')
                      }
                    >
                      <Heart className={'w-5 h-5 ' + (isLiked ? 'fill-white' : '')} />
                    </button>

                  </div>

                  {/* Subtle Bottom-Only Gradient with Full-Width Non-Overlapping Text */}
                  <div className="absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 pt-10 pb-2.5 px-3 z-10 pointer-events-none bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 via-black/25 to-transparent">
                    <Link href={'/profile/' + profile.id} className="block min-w-0 pointer-events-auto">
                      {/* Line 1: Name + Age + Verified Check */}
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 min-w-0">
                        <h3
                          className="text-sm font-bold text-white leading-tight truncate"
                          style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-brand)' }}
                        >
                          {displayName}
                        </h3>
                        {profile.age ? (
                          <span
                            className="text-sm font-bold text-white leading-tight shrink-0"
                            style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-brand)' }}
                          >
                            , {profile.age}
                          </span>
                        ) : null}
                        {profile.verified && (
                          <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white shrink-0 ml-0.5" />
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Line 2: Location (City, Country) */}
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-white/90 font-medium mt-0.5 truncate">
                        {formattedLocation}
                      </p>

                      {/* Line 3: Single Clean Line for Intent / Relationship Goal */}
                      <p className="text-[10.5px] text-white/80 font-normal mt-0.5 truncate">
                        {conciseGoal}
                      </p>
                    </Link>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>

        {!isLoading && filteredProfiles.length === 0 && (
          <div className="mt-4 p-8 rounded-2xl bg-white border border-[#DDD7E5] text-center space-y-3 shadow-xs">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto rounded-2xl bg-[#F3EFFC] flex items-center justify-center text-[#6555B8]">
              <Search className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <p
              className="text-base font-bold text-[#1C1924]"
              style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-brand)' }}
            >
              No profiles match your current filters
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#6C637B] max-w-xs mx-auto leading-relaxed">
              Tap below to reset your filters to your saved preference ({viewerSavedGenders.map((g) => GENDER_LABELS[g] || g).join(', ') || 'All'}), or open Filters to adjust who you are looking for.
            </p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={resetFilters}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-full bg-[#6555B8] text-white hover:bg-[#52449e] transition shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Reset Filters</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  userSelectedGenderManually.current = true;
                  setSelectedGenders([]);
                  setSelectedCountry('All');
                  setDiscoveryMode('all');
                }}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-full bg-white border border-[#DDD7E5] text-[#524B5E] hover:bg-[#F3EFFC] hover:text-[#6555B8] transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <span>Show Everyone</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {hasMore && (
          <div className="pt-4 pb-2 flex justify-center">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setVisibleLimit((prev) => prev + BATCH_SIZE)}
              className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-full bg-white border border-[#DDD7E5] text-[#1C1924] hover:border-[#6555B8] text-xs font-semibold transition shadow-xs"
            >
              Load More Profiles ({filteredProfiles.length - visibleLimit} remaining)
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {lastPassed && (
          <div className="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-full bg-white/95 border border-[#DDD7E5] shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-md">
            <span className="text-xs text-[#1C1924]">Passed <strong>{lastPassed.name}</strong></span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={undoLastPass}
              className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#6555B8] hover:bg-[#52449e] text-white text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition shadow-sm"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
              Undo
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </main>

      {/* Filter Drawer */}
      {filtersOpen && (
        <>
          <div
            className="fixed inset-0 z-[120] bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm transition-opacity duration-200"
            onClick={() => setFiltersOpen(false)}
          />
          <div className="fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-[121] w-full max-w-lg mx-auto bg-white rounded-t-3xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[85vh] pb-[max(1.5rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]">

function DiscoverFeed() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<div className="min-h-screen bg-[#F8F7FA] text-[#1C1924] p-8 text-center text-xs">Loading discover feed...</div>}>
      <DiscoverContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
function HeroGate() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [authState, setAuthState] = useState<'loading' | 'signedOut' | 'member'>('loading');
  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    supabase.auth.getUser().then(({ data }) => {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setAuthState(data?.user ? 'member' : 'signedOut');
    });
    return () => { mounted = false; };
  }, []);

  // Signed-in members get the real feed at /discover - redirect instead of
  // rendering the legacy duplicate feed from this file.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (authState === 'member') router.replace('/discover');
  }, [authState, router]);

  if (authState === 'loading') {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#0d0b14] flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-4 border-[#6555B8] border-t-transparent"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (authState === 'signedOut') return <HeroLanding />;
  return null;
}

export default HeroGate;

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase/client';

interface AccountBottomSheetProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function AccountBottomSheet({ isOpen, onClose }: AccountBottomSheetProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<any>(null);

  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [dragY, setDragY] = useState(0);
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const touchStartY = useRef(0);
  const isClosingRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      isClosingRef.current = false;
      setMounted(true);
      setDragY(0);
      window.history.pushState({ accountDrawer: true }, '');

      const handlePopState = () => {
        closeWithAnimation();
      };
      window.addEventListener('popstate', handlePopState);
      return () => {
        window.removeEventListener('popstate', handlePopState);
      };
    } else if (mounted) {
      closeWithAnimation();
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  const closeWithAnimation = () => {
    if (isClosingRef.current) return;
    isClosingRef.current = true;
    setDragY(window.innerHeight || 650);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setMounted(false);
      setDragY(0);
      onClose();
    }, 250);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    async function fetchAccountData() {
      try {
        const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
        if (user) {
          const { data } = await supabase
            .from('profiles')
            .select('*')
            .eq('id', user.id)
            .single();

          setProfile(data || { full_name: 'Member', email: user.email });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Account sheet fetch:', err);
      }
    }
    fetchAccountData();
  }, [isOpen]);

  const handleTouchStart = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    touchStartY.current = e.touches[0].clientY;
    setIsDragging(true);
  };

  const handleTouchMove = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    const deltaY = e.touches[0].clientY - touchStartY.current;
    if (deltaY > 0) {
      setDragY(deltaY);
    } else {
      setDragY(deltaY * 0.15);
    }
  };

  const handleTouchEnd = () => {
    setIsDragging(false);
    if (dragY > 90) {
      closeWithAnimation();
    } else {
      setDragY(0);
    }
  };

  const handleSignOut = async () => {
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
    closeWithAnimation();
    window.location.href = '/';
  };

  if (!isOpen && !mounted) return null;

  const initials = profile?.full_name
    ? profile.full_name.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()
    : 'ME';

  const progress = Math.min(Math.max(dragY / 400, 0), 1);
  const backdropOpacity = (1 - progress) * 0.75;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-end justify-center pointer-events-auto">
      <div
        onClick={closeWithAnimation}
        style={{
          opacity: backdropOpacity,
          transition: isDragging ? 'none' : 'opacity 0.25s ease-out',
        }}
        className="fixed inset-0 bg-black backdrop-blur-sm"
        aria-hidden="true"
      />

      {/* Standardized curvature to rounded-t-[28px] */}
      <div
        style={{
          transform: `translate3d(0, ${dragY}px, 0)`,
          transition: isDragging ? 'none' : 'transform 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)',
        }}
        className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-[#2D2F4C] border-t border-[#9A8CC3]/40 rounded-t-[28px] p-5 pb-8 shadow-2xl z-10 max-h-[85dvh] flex flex-col justify-between overflow-y-auto select-none will-change-transform"
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          
          {/* Active Grab Area */}
          <div
            onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
            onTouchMove={handleTouchMove}
            onTouchEnd={handleTouchEnd}
            className="w-full pt-1 pb-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing touch-none"
          >
            <div className="w-14 h-1.5 bg-[#9A8CC3]/60 rounded-full" />
          </div>

          <div
            onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
            onTouchMove={handleTouchMove}
            onTouchEnd={handleTouchEnd}
            className="pb-2 border-b border-[#9A8CC3]/25 touch-none"
          >
            <h2 className="text-xl font-medium text-[#1C1924] ">
              Your Account
            </h2>
          </div>

          {/* User Profile Summary: Circular rounded-full avatar matching chat rows */}
          <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[#1E1F30] border border-[#9A8CC3]/30 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-md">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-[#6555B8] text-white flex items-center justify-center font-medium text-base border border-[#9A8CC3]/50 shadow-inner flex-shrink-0">
                {initials}
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-base font-medium text-[#1C1924]">
                  {profile?.full_name || 'Your Profile'}
                  {profile?.age ? `, ${profile.age}` : ''}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-[#B2A4D7] flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
                  <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#9A8CC3]" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M17.657 16.657L13.414 20.9a1.998 1.998 0 01-2.827 0l-4.244-4.243a8 8 0 1111.314 0z" />
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 11a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" />
                  </svg>
                  {profile?.city ? `${profile.city}, ${profile.country}` : 'Profile Incomplete'}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <Link
              href="/profile"
              onClick={closeWithAnimation}
              className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[#2D2F4C] hover:bg-[#6555B8]/30 border border-[#9A8CC3]/40 text-white hover:text-white text-xs font-medium transition-all active:scale-95"
            >
              Edit
            </Link>
          </div>

          {/* Verification Status Card */}
          <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[#1E1F30] border border-[#9A8CC3]/35 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-md">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-[#9A8CC3]" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m5.618-4.016A11.955 11.955 0 0112 2.944a11.955 11.955 0 01-8.618 3.04A12.02 12.02 0 003 9c0 5.591 3.824 10.29 9 11.622 5.176-1.332 9-6.03 9-11.622 0-1.042-.133-2.052-.382-3.016z" />
                </svg>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-[#1C1924]">
                  {profile?.is_verified ? 'Identity Verified' : 'Pose Unverified'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#B2A4D7] leading-relaxed">
                {profile?.is_verified
                  ? 'Your profile carries the verified courtship badge.'
                  : 'Earn your verified badge with a 10-second selfie pose.'}
              </p>
            </div>

            {!profile?.is_verified && (
              <Link

              >
                Verify
              </Link>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Navigation Action Rows */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Link
              href="/profile"
              onClick={closeWithAnimation}
              className="flex items-center justify-between p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#1E1F30]/90 hover:bg-[#1E1F30] border border-[#9A8CC3]/30 text-white font-medium text-sm transition-all active:scale-[0.985]"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-[#9A8CC3]" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">

import React from 'react';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { Navbar } from './Navbar';

const EXCLUDED_ROUTES = ['/login', '/onboarding'];

export function AppHeader() {
  const pathname = usePathname();

  // Hide the global navigation bar on dedicated authentication & onboarding screens
  if (EXCLUDED_ROUTES.some((route) => pathname.startsWith(route))) {
    return null;
  }

  return <Navbar />;
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { 
  Compass, 
  Heart,
  Zap, 
  MessageCircle, 
  User 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase/client';

const PUBLIC_ROUTES = [
  '/',
  '/login',
  '/signup',
  '/forgot-password',
  '/terms',
  '/privacy',
  '/standards',
  '/pricing'
];

export function BottomNav() {
  const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState(0);
  const [user, setUser] = useState<any>(null);
  const [isKeyboardOpen, setIsKeyboardOpen] = useState(false);
  const pathname = usePathname();

  const isActive = (path: string) => {
    if (!pathname) return false;
    if (path === '/discover') return pathname === '/discover';
    return pathname === path || pathname.startsWith(`${path}/`);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    let channel: any = null;
    let isCancelled = false;

    const fetchAndSubscribeUnread = async () => {
      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
      if (!session || isCancelled) return;
      const uid = session.user.id;
      setUser(session.user);

      const { count } = await supabase
        .from('messages')
        .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
        .eq('receiver_id', uid)
        .eq('is_read', false);

      if (isCancelled) return;
      setUnreadCount(count || 0);

      const channelName = `nav-unread-${uid}-${Date.now()}`;
      channel = supabase
        .channel(channelName)
        .on(
          'postgres_changes',
          {
            event: '*',
            schema: 'public',
            table: 'messages',
            filter: `receiver_id=eq.${uid}`,
          },
          async () => {
            if (isCancelled) return;
            const { count: freshCount } = await supabase
              .from('messages')
              .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
              .eq('receiver_id', uid)
              .eq('is_read', false);
            if (!isCancelled) {
              setUnreadCount(freshCount || 0);
            }
          }
        )
        .subscribe();
    };

    fetchAndSubscribeUnread();

    const { data: { subscription } } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event: any, session: any) => {
      setUser(session?.user ?? null);
      if (session?.user) {
        fetchAndSubscribeUnread();
      } else {
        setUnreadCount(0);
      }
    });

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
      if (channel) {
        supabase.removeChannel(channel);
      }
      subscription.unsubscribe();
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.visualViewport) return;

    const handleResize = () => {
      if (!window.visualViewport) return;
      const isKeyboard = window.visualViewport.height < window.innerHeight * 0.82;
      setIsKeyboardOpen(isKeyboard);
    };

    window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => {
      window.visualViewport?.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    };
  }, []);

  if (!user || PUBLIC_ROUTES.includes(pathname) || pathname?.startsWith('/onboarding')) {
    return null;
  }

  const navItems = [
    { href: '/discover', label: 'Discover', icon: Compass },
    { href: '/favorites', label: 'Sparks', icon: Zap },
    { href: '/messages', label: 'Messages', icon: MessageCircle, badge: unreadCount },
    { href: '/profile', label: 'Profile', icon: User },
  ];

  return (
    <div 
      className={`fixed bottom-3.5 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-[calc(100%-1.75rem)] max-w-[390px] z-50 transition-all duration-300 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)] ${
        isKeyboardOpen ? 'translate-y-24 opacity-0 pointer-events-none' : 'translate-y-0 opacity-100'
      }`}
    >
      <nav className="bg-white/92 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-[#E5E1EC]/80 shadow-[0_12px_36px_rgba(101,85,184,0.14),0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] rounded-full px-2 py-1.5 flex items-center justify-around select-none">
        {navItems.map((item) => {
          const active = isActive(item.href);
          const Icon = item.icon;

          return (
            <Link
              key={item.href}
              href={item.href}
              className={`relative flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-1 px-2 rounded-2xl transition-all duration-200 ease-out active:scale-95 select-none cursor-pointer ${
                active 
                  ? 'text-[#6555B8]' 
                  : 'text-[#8C849B] hover:text-[#524B5E]'
              }`}
              aria-label={item.label}
            >
              <div className="relative">
                <Icon 
                  className={`w-5 h-5 transition-transform duration-200 ${active ? 'scale-110' : ''}`} 
                  strokeWidth={active ? 2.3 : 1.75} 
                />
                {Boolean(item.badge && item.badge > 0) && (
                  <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-2.5 min-w-[16px] h-4 px-1 rounded-full bg-[#E05375] text-[10px] font-bold text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs pointer-events-none">
                    {item.badge! > 9 ? '9+' : item.badge}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <span className={`text-[10px] tracking-tight mt-0.5 leading-tight transition-colors duration-200 ${
                active ? 'font-bold text-[#6555B8]' : 'font-medium text-[#8C849B]'
              }`}>
                {item.label}
              </span>
            </Link>
          );
        })}
      </nav>
    </div>
  );
}

export default BottomNav;

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';

interface BrandLogoProps {
  className?: string;
  href?: string;
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  textSize?: string;
}

const SIZE_CLASS: Record<'sm' | 'md' | 'lg', string> = {
  sm: 'text-[15px]',
  md: 'text-[17px]',
  lg: 'text-[20px]',
};

export function BrandLogo({ className = '', href = '/discover', size = 'md', textSize = '' }: BrandLogoProps) {
  const wordmark = (
    <span
      className={[
        textSize || SIZE_CLASS[size],
        'leading-none font-bold lowercase select-none inline-flex items-baseline',
        className,
      ].filter(Boolean).join(' ')}
      style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-logo), sans-serif', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '-0.02em' }}
    >
      <span className="text-[#1C1924]">asians</span>
      <span className="text-[#6555B8]">inlove</span>
    </span>
  );

  if (href) {
    return (
      <Link href={href} className="inline-flex items-center focus:outline-none">
        {wordmark}
      </Link>
    );
  }

  return wordmark;
}

export default BrandLogo;

===== FILE: C:\Users\sands\asiansin-love\components\ChatInterface.tsx =====
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase/client';
import { CheckCircle, ArrowLeft, Send, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';

export interface TargetUserProfile {
  id: string;
  fullName: string;
  age: number;
  city: string;
  country: string;
  avatarUrl: string;
  galleryUrls?: string[];
  isVerified: boolean;
  relationshipIntent: string;
  jobTitle?: string;
  languages?: string[];
  bio?: string;
  trustPill?: string;
  trustStatus?: string;
  reputationScore?: number;
  childrenStatus?: string;
}

export interface MessageItem {
  id: string;
  sender_id: string;
  receiver_id: string;
  recipient_id?: string;
  content: string;
  created_at: string;
  is_read?: boolean;
  read?: boolean;
  is_quarantined?: boolean;
}

interface ChatInterfaceProps {
  currentUserId: string;
  targetUser: TargetUserProfile;
  initialMessages?: MessageItem[];
}

export function ChatInterface({ currentUserId, targetUser, initialMessages = [] }: ChatInterfaceProps) {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<MessageItem[]>(initialMessages);
  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [warningMessage, setWarningMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [feedbackSuccess, setFeedbackSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const scrollToBottom = () => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    scrollToBottom();
  }, [messages]);

  // Mark unread messages as read
  useEffect(() => {
    async function markAsRead() {
      if (!currentUserId || currentUserId.startsWith('00000000')) return;

      const unreadIds = messages
        .filter((m) => {
          const recId = m.receiver_id || m.recipient_id;
          const readStatus = m.is_read ?? m.read;
          return m.sender_id === targetUser.id && recId === currentUserId && !readStatus;
        })
        .map((m) => m.id);

      if (unreadIds.length > 0) {
        try {
          await supabase
            .from('messages')
            .update({ is_read: true })
            .in('id', unreadIds);
        } catch {
          // Non-blocking catch
        }
      }
    }
    markAsRead();
  }, [messages, currentUserId, targetUser.id]);

  // Supabase Realtime channel subscription
  useEffect(() => {
    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`chat_${targetUser.id}_${currentUserId}`)
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        {
          event: '*',
          schema: 'public',
          table: 'messages',
        },
        (payload: any) => {
          const eventType = payload.eventType || payload.event;

          if (eventType === 'INSERT') {
            const rawMsg = payload.new as any;

            // Hide quarantined messages from the recipient, allow sender to view
            if (rawMsg.is_quarantined && rawMsg.sender_id !== currentUserId) {
              return;
            }

            const recId = rawMsg.receiver_id || rawMsg.recipient_id;
            const newMsg: MessageItem = {
              id: rawMsg.id,
              sender_id: rawMsg.sender_id,
              receiver_id: recId,
              recipient_id: recId,
              content: rawMsg.content,
              created_at: rawMsg.created_at,
              is_read: rawMsg.is_read ?? rawMsg.read ?? false,
              read: rawMsg.is_read ?? rawMsg.read ?? false,
              is_quarantined: rawMsg.is_quarantined ?? false,
            };

            const isRelevant =
              (newMsg.sender_id === currentUserId && recId === targetUser.id) ||
              (newMsg.sender_id === targetUser.id && recId === currentUserId);

            if (isRelevant) {
              setMessages((prev) => {
                if (prev.some((m) => m.id === newMsg.id)) return prev;
                return [...prev, newMsg];
              });
            }
          } else if (eventType === 'UPDATE') {
            const updatedRaw = payload.new as any;
            const recId = updatedRaw.receiver_id || updatedRaw.recipient_id;

            const isRelevant =
              (updatedRaw.sender_id === currentUserId && recId === targetUser.id) ||
              (updatedRaw.sender_id === targetUser.id && recId === currentUserId);

            if (!isRelevant) return;

            if (updatedRaw.is_quarantined && updatedRaw.sender_id !== currentUserId) {
              setMessages((prev) => prev.filter((m) => m.id !== updatedRaw.id));
              return;
            }

            const formattedMsg: MessageItem = {
              id: updatedRaw.id,
              sender_id: updatedRaw.sender_id,
              receiver_id: recId,
              recipient_id: recId,
              content: updatedRaw.content,
              created_at: updatedRaw.created_at,
              is_read: updatedRaw.is_read ?? updatedRaw.read ?? false,
              read: updatedRaw.is_read ?? updatedRaw.read ?? false,
              is_quarantined: updatedRaw.is_quarantined ?? false,
            };

            setMessages((prev) => {
              const exists = prev.some((m) => m.id === updatedRaw.id);
              if (exists) {
                return prev.map((m) => (m.id === updatedRaw.id ? formattedMsg : m));
              }
              return [...prev, formattedMsg].sort(
                (a, b) => new Date(a.created_at).getTime() - new Date(b.created_at).getTime()
              );
            });
          }
        }
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      supabase.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, [currentUserId, targetUser.id]);

  const handleSendMessage = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const cleanContent = input.trim();
    if (!cleanContent || isSending) return;

    setIsSending(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/messages', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          receiverId: targetUser.id,
          recipientId: targetUser.id,
          content: cleanContent,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        setErrorMessage(data.error || 'Message could not be sent.');
      } else {
        setInput('');

        if (data.warning) {
          setWarningMessage(data.warning);
        } else {
          setWarningMessage(null);
        }

        if (data.message) {
          const recId = data.message.receiver_id || data.message.recipient_id;
          const formatted: MessageItem = {
            id: data.message.id,
            sender_id: data.message.sender_id,
            receiver_id: recId,
            recipient_id: recId,
            content: data.message.content,
            created_at: data.message.created_at,
            is_read: data.message.is_read ?? data.message.read ?? false,
            read: data.message.is_read ?? data.message.read ?? false,
            is_quarantined: data.message.is_quarantined ?? false,
          };

          setMessages((prev) => {
            if (prev.some((m) => m.id === formatted.id)) return prev;
            return [...prev, formatted];
          });
        }
      }
    } catch {
      setErrorMessage('Network transmission error.');
    } finally {
      setIsSending(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-[calc(100vh-64px)] max-w-4xl mx-auto bg-[#FAFAFD] border-x border-[#E5E1EC]">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#E5E1EC] sticky top-0 z-20">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Link
            href="/messages"
            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[#524B5E] hover:text-[#1C1924] hover:bg-[#F3EFFC] transition"
            aria-label="Back to messages"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Link>
          <Link href={`/profile/${targetUser.id}`} className="flex items-center gap-2.5 group">
            {targetUser.avatarUrl ? (
              <img
                src={targetUser.avatarUrl}
                alt={targetUser.fullName}
                className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full object-cover border border-[#DDD7E5]"
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-[#F3EFFC] text-[#6555B8] flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-medium">
                {targetUser.fullName.charAt(0)}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="font-medium text-[#1C1924] text-sm group-hover:text-[#6555B8] transition truncate">
                {targetUser.fullName}{targetUser.age ? `, ${targetUser.age}` : ''}
              </span>
              {targetUser.isVerified && (
                <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#6555B8] shrink-0" />
              )}
            </div>
          </Link>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {targetUser.reputationScore !== undefined && (
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[#F3EFFC] text-[#6555B8] border border-[#DDD7E5]">
              {targetUser.reputationScore}% Rep
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Messages Feed */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-3">
        {errorMessage && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-2xl text-rose-700 text-xs text-center font-medium shadow-xs">
            {errorMessage}
          </div>
        )}
        {warningMessage && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-2xl text-amber-850 text-xs font-medium shadow-xs flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
              <span>{warningMessage}</span>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setWarningMessage(null)}
              className="text-amber-700 hover:text-amber-950 font-bold px-1.5 text-sm"
              aria-label="Dismiss warning"
            >
              ×
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
        {feedbackSuccess && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-2xl text-emerald-700 text-xs text-center font-medium shadow-xs">
            {feedbackSuccess}
          </div>
        )}
        {messages.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="h-full flex items-center justify-center text-center p-8 text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#756D82]">
            <div>
              <p className="font-semibold text-[#1C1924] mb-1">Begin your intentional conversation</p>
              <p>Say hello with sincere interest and mutual respect.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          messages.map((msg) => {
            const isMe = msg.sender_id === currentUserId;
            return (
              <div
                key={msg.id}
                className={`flex flex-col ${isMe ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'} animate-[pairsPageIn_240ms_cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)_both] will-change-transform`}
              >
                <div
                  className={`max-w-[78%] px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl text-xs sm:text-sm leading-relaxed shadow-xs ${
                    isMe
                      ? 'bg-[#6555B8] text-white rounded-br-xs shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(101,85,184,0.22)] active:scale-[0.99] transition-transform'
                      : 'bg-white text-[#1C1924] border border-[#E5E1EC] rounded-bl-xs shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] active:scale-[0.99] transition-transform'
                  }`}
                >
                  {msg.content}
                </div>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8C849B] mt-0.5 px-1.5 font-medium">
                  {new Date(msg.created_at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                </span>
              </div>
            );
          })
        )}
        <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
      </div>

      {/* Input Row */}
      <form
        onSubmit={handleSendMessage}
        className="p-3 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-[#E5E1EC] flex items-center gap-2 pb-[max(0.75rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]"
      >
        <input
          type="text"
          value={input}
          onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Write a sincere message..."
          className="flex-1 bg-[#F7F6FA] border border-[#DDD7E5] rounded-full px-4 py-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#1C1924] placeholder-[#8C849B] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#6555B8] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#6555B8]/15 transition-all shadow-xs"
        />
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={!input.trim() || isSending}
          className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-[#6555B8] hover:bg-[#52449E] disabled:opacity-40 text-white rounded-full text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold transition-all duration-200 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)] active:scale-90 shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 select-none cursor-pointer"
        >
          <span>Send</span>
          <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { MapPin, ShieldCheck, Heart } from 'lucide-react';
import { PlusBadge } from '@/components/PlusBadge';

interface DiscoverCardProps {
  isPlus?: boolean;
  id: string;
  name: string;
  age: number;
  location: string;
  avatarUrl: string;
  repScore?: number;
  online?: boolean;
}

export function DiscoverCard({
  id,
  name,
  age,
  location,
  avatarUrl,
  repScore = 100,
  online = true,
  isPlus = false,
}: DiscoverCardProps) {
  const [liked, setLiked] = useState(false);

  const handleLike = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setLiked((prev) => !prev);
  };

  return (
    <Link
      href={`/profile/${id}`}

    >

        <img
          src={avatarUrl}
          alt={name}
          className="h-full w-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-[1.03]"
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="h-full w-full bg-gradient-to-br from-[#ECE7F6] to-[#DDD5EE] flex items-center justify-center">
          <span className="text-3xl font-medium text-[#6555B8]/40">{name?.[0] || '?'}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Feathered Scrim (only bottom 35% for contrast) */}
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-1/2 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-black/30 to-transparent" />

      {/* Top Floating Glass Badges */}
      <div className="absolute top-2.5 left-2.5 right-2.5 flex items-center justify-between pointer-events-none z-10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          {isPlus && <PlusBadge size="sm" />}
          {repScore > 0 && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-black/30 backdrop-blur-md text-[10px] font-medium text-white/95 border border-white/20 shadow-sm">
              <ShieldCheck className="h-3 w-3 text-[#D8B4FE]" />
              <span>{repScore}%</span>
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {online && (
          <span className="presence-dot h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 ring-2 ring-white/90 shadow" />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Bottom Identity & Tactile Action */}
      <div className="absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 p-3 flex items-end justify-between gap-2 z-10">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <h2 className="text-[15px] font-medium text-white  truncate drop-shadow-sm">
            {name}, {age}
          </h2>

          <p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-white/85 font-medium mt-0.5 truncate drop-shadow-sm">
            <MapPin className="h-3 w-3 text-white/70 shrink-0" />
            <span className="truncate">{location}</span>
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Circular Heart Button */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleLike}
          aria-label={liked ? 'Unlike' : 'Like'}
          className={`h-8 w-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center backdrop-blur-md transition-all duration-200 active:scale-90 shrink-0 ${
            liked

          }`}

===== FILE: C:\Users\sands\asiansin-love\components\GestureVerifyModal.tsx =====
'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { Camera, RefreshCw, X, ShieldCheck, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';

export type VerificationPose = 'peace' | 'chin' | 'palm' | 'three';

interface PoseMetadata {
  id: VerificationPose;
  label: string;
  instruction: string;
  imageSrc: string;
}

const POSES: Record<VerificationPose, PoseMetadata> = {
  peace: {
    id: 'peace',
    label: 'Peace Sign Beside Cheek',
    instruction: 'Hold up two fingers in a V sign right beside your cheek or temple.',
    imageSrc: '/images/verification/pose-peace.png',
  },
  chin: {
    id: 'chin',
    label: 'Finger on Chin',
    instruction: 'Rest your index finger under your chin while looking directly into the camera.',
    imageSrc: '/images/verification/pose-chin.png',
  },
  palm: {
    id: 'palm',
    label: 'Open Palm Facing Forward',
    instruction: 'Hold up an open palm facing forward next to your ear.',
    imageSrc: '/images/verification/pose-palm.png',
  },
  three: {
    id: 'three',
    label: 'Three Fingers Up',
    instruction: 'Hold up three fingers (index, middle, ring) upright beside your face.',
    imageSrc: '/images/verification/pose-three.png',
  },
};

const POSE_KEYS: VerificationPose[] = ['peace', 'chin', 'palm', 'three'];

interface GestureVerifyModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess?: () => void;
}

export default function GestureVerifyModal({ isOpen, onClose, onSuccess }: GestureVerifyModalProps) {
  const [currentPose, setCurrentPose] = useState<PoseMetadata>(POSES.peace);
  const [stream, setStream] = useState<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [capturedBlob, setCapturedBlob] = useState<Blob | null>(null);
  const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'submitting' | 'approved' | 'denied'>('idle');
  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState('');

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  // Pick a random pose on open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      const randomPose = POSE_KEYS[Math.floor(Math.random() * POSE_KEYS.length)];
      setCurrentPose(POSES[randomPose]);
      setCapturedBlob(null);
      setPreviewUrl(null);
      setStatus('idle');
      setStatusMessage('');
      startCamera();
    } else {
      stopCamera();
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  const stopCamera = useCallback(() => {
    if (stream) {
      stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      setStream(null);
    }
  }, [stream]);

  const startCamera = useCallback(async () => {
    setCameraError(null);
    try {
      if (stream) {
        stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      }

      const mediaStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: {
          facingMode: 'user',
          width: { ideal: 1280 },
          height: { ideal: 720 },
        },
        audio: false,
      });

      setStream(mediaStream);
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = mediaStream;
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err.name === 'NotAllowedError' || err.name === 'PermissionDeniedError') {
        setCameraError('Camera permission was denied. Please allow camera access in your browser to verify.');
      } else if (err.name === 'NotFoundError' || err.name === 'DevicesNotFoundError') {
        setCameraError('No camera found on this device. Live camera is required for verification.');
      } else {
        setCameraError('Unable to open camera stream. Please check browser permissions.');
      }
    }
  }, [stream]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      stopCamera();
      if (previewUrl) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
      }
    };
  }, [stopCamera, previewUrl]);

  // Capture frame directly from WebRTC video stream (Zero File Upload)
  const takePhoto = () => {
    if (!videoRef.current || !canvasRef.current) return;

    const video = videoRef.current;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;

    canvas.width = video.videoWidth || 640;
    canvas.height = video.videoHeight || 480;

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    // Flip horizontally to mirror the natural camera reflection
    ctx.translate(canvas.width, 0);
    ctx.scale(-1, 1);
    ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    canvas.toBlob(
      (blob) => {
        if (blob) {
          setCapturedBlob(blob);
          setPreviewUrl(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
        }
      },
      'image/jpeg',
      0.92
    );
  };

  const retakePhoto = () => {
    if (previewUrl) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
    }
    setCapturedBlob(null);
    setPreviewUrl(null);
    setStatus('idle');
    setStatusMessage('');
  };

  const submitVerification = async () => {
    if (!capturedBlob) return;

    setStatus('submitting');
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('photo', capturedBlob, 'verification.jpg');
      formData.append('pose', currentPose.id);

      const res = await fetch('/api/verify', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData,
      });

      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));

      if (res.ok && data.success) {
        setStatus('approved');
        setStatusMessage(data.message || 'Pose confirmed! Your profile is now verified.');
        stopCamera();
        if (onSuccess) {
          setTimeout(onSuccess, 1800);
        }
      } else {
        setStatus('denied');
        setStatusMessage(data.error || 'The gesture could not be matched. Please match the pose illustration and try again.');
      }
    } catch {
      setStatus('denied');
      setStatusMessage('Verification request failed. Please check your connection and retry.');
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md bg-white rounded-3xl border border-[#DDD7E5] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden p-5 space-y-4">
        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[#F0EDF5]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-[#6555B8]" />
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#1C1924]">Member Pose Verification</h2>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1 text-[#8C849B] hover:text-[#1C1924] rounded-full hover:bg-[#FAF8FD] transition"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Status: Approved View */}
        {status === 'approved' ? (
          <div className="py-6 text-center space-y-4">
            <div className="relative w-36 h-36 mx-auto rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-[#DDD7E5] bg-white shadow-xs">
              <Image
                src="/images/verification/status-approved.png"
                alt="Verification Approved"
                fill
                className="object-contain"
                priority
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-[#1C1924]">Verification Complete</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#524B5E] max-w-xs mx-auto">{statusMessage}</p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="w-full py-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#6555B8] text-white text-xs font-bold hover:bg-[#53449E] transition"
            >
              Done
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : status === 'denied' ? (
          /* Status: Denied View */
          <div className="py-6 text-center space-y-4">
            <div className="relative w-36 h-36 mx-auto rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-[#E05375]/30 bg-white shadow-xs">
              <Image
                src="/images/verification/status-denied.png"
                alt="Verification Denied"
                fill
                className="object-contain"
                priority
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-[#1C1924]">Pose Not Recognized</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#524B5E] max-w-xs mx-auto">{statusMessage}</p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={retakePhoto}
              className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#6555B8] text-white text-xs font-bold hover:bg-[#53449E] transition"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
              Try Again
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* Active Verification Flow */
          <>
            {/* Compact Pose Instruction Strip */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 bg-[#FAF8FD] border border-[#DDD7E5] rounded-xl p-2 select-none">
              <div className="relative w-12 h-12 shrink-0 rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-white border border-[#DDD7E5] p-0.5">
                <Image
                  src={currentPose.imageSrc}
                  alt={currentPose.label}
                  fill
                  className="object-contain"
                  priority
                />
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-left">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="inline-block bg-[#6555B8] text-white text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Required Pose
                  </span>
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#1C1924] truncate">{currentPose.label}</p>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-[#524B5E] leading-tight line-clamp-2 mt-0.5">{currentPose.instruction}</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Camera Viewport / Photo Snapshot (Centered 240px frame with Oval Face Guide) */}
            <div className="relative w-full max-w-[240px] aspect-square mx-auto rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-black flex items-center justify-center border border-[#DDD7E5] shadow-inner">
              {cameraError ? (
                <div className="p-4 text-center text-white space-y-2">
                  <AlertCircle className="w-6 h-6 text-[#E05375] mx-auto" />
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-200">{cameraError}</p>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={startCamera}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-[#6555B8] text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl"
                  >
                    Retry Camera
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : capturedBlob && previewUrl ? (
                <img src={previewUrl} alt="Captured verification" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
              ) : (
                <>
                  <video
                    ref={videoRef}
                    autoPlay
                    playsInline
                    muted
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover -scale-x-100"
                  />
                  {/* Subtle Oval Face Guide */}
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none flex items-center justify-center">
                    <div className="w-[170px] h-[210px] rounded-[50%] border-2 border-white/50 border-dashed" />
                    <span className="absolute bottom-2 text-[10px] font-medium text-white/90 bg-black/60 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full backdrop-blur-xs">
                      Align face & match hand pose
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </>
              )}
            </div>

            <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="hidden" />

            {/* Action Buttons */}
            <div className="pt-1">
              {capturedBlob ? (
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={retakePhoto}
                    disabled={status === 'submitting'}
                    className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-3 rounded-2xl border border-[#DDD7E5] text-xs font-bold text-[#524B5E] hover:bg-[#FAF8FD] transition disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Retake
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={submitVerification}
                    disabled={status === 'submitting'}
                    className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#6555B8] text-white text-xs font-bold hover:bg-[#53449E] transition disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {status === 'submitting' ? 'Verifying...' : 'Submit Verification'}
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={takePhoto}
                  disabled={Boolean(cameraError)}
                  className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#6555B8] text-white text-xs font-bold hover:bg-[#53449E] transition shadow-md disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <Camera className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Take Photo Now
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </>
        )}
